item.title: SpaceX y Tesla avanzan en negociaciones para una posible fusión, según fuentes
item.description: La fusión supondría un gran éxito para los negociadores de Wall Street, ya que crearía un conglomerado que abarcaría vehículos eléctricos, baterías de almacenamiento de energía, cohetes y satélites.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Gould, Siddharth Philip, Dinesh Nair
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — SpaceX y Tesla Inc. ( TSLA ) están avanzando en sus negociaciones de fusión, preparando el terreno para una combinación que podría redefinir los límites de las fusiones y adquisiciones a nivel mundial. Según fuentes cercanas al asunto, las dos mayores empresas de Elon Musk podrían anunciar la que sería la mayor operación de su historia tan pronto como en diciembre. Este calendario tan ambicioso refleja la tendencia de Musk a actuar con rapidez en sus movimientos empresariales. Ver más: Anthropic saldrá a bolsa con acciones entre US$70 y US$78 y busca hasta US$90.400 millones, más que SpaceX Las empresas también han evaluado un escenario en el que el anuncio se retrasaría hasta principios de 2027, según indicaron dichas fuentes, que solicitaron mantener el anonimato debido al carácter privado de las conversaciones. Sus consejos de administración y asesores están ultimando los términos de la fusión y la estructura de gobierno de la entidad combinada, entre otros asuntos, según afirmaron las fuentes. Los representantes de Tesla y SpaceX no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios. Las acciones de Tesla se dispararon hasta alcanzar su máximo de la sesión, con una subida de hasta el 1,9%, mientras que las de SpaceX subieron un 0,5% a las 15:20 horas del jueves en Nueva York. La fusión supondría un gran éxito para los negociadores de Wall Street, ya que crearía un conglomerado que abarcaría vehículos eléctricos, baterías de almacenamiento de energía, cohetes y satélites. La razón para reunir todos esos activos bajo un mismo techo radica en la ambición compartida de aprovechar la inteligencia artificial en los ámbitos espacial, de los vehículos autónomos y de los robots humanoides. Sin embargo, ambas empresas tendrán que hacer frente a diversos obstáculos antes de poder cerrar la operación, entre ellos cómo aislar las operaciones de Tesla en China, según las fuentes. Ver más: Jensen Huang deja Nvidia tras el escándalo y Elon Musk se adelanta: dice que sería un honor contratarlo Según explicó el analista de JPMorgan, Rajat Gupta, a sus clientes en una nota de investigación el mes pasado, las cuestiones de seguridad nacional relacionadas con los contratos de SpaceX con el gobierno estadounidense y el sector de defensa, así como la gran y rentable presencia manufacturera de Tesla en China, se perfilan como “dinámicas clave que entran en conflicto entre sí” a la hora de obtener las aprobaciones regulatorias y de los accionistas para un acuerdo. La fusión supondría una importante prueba para el clima político tras las elecciones de mitad de legislatura en EE.UU. Los demócratas, que han tomado el control del Congreso, se han comprometido a investigar las actividades empresariales y políticas de Musk. Musk declaró en octubre que los consejos de administración de ambas empresas habían constituido comités especiales formados por consejeros independientes para estudiar la posibilidad de fusionarse. SpaceX tiene un valor de mercado de más de US$1,9 billones tras su salida a bolsa, mientras que Tesla está valorada en unos US$1,5 billones. Está previsto que Tesla celebre su junta general anual de accionistas el 3 de diciembre. Bloomberg News había informado de que SpaceX y Tesla estaban presionando para anunciar un acuerdo durante el primer semestre del próximo año, con el objetivo de cerrar la fusión antes de que finalice el mandato del presidente Donald Trump. Uno de los factores que se están debatiendo es el número de acciones que SpaceX tendrá que ofrecer a los inversores de Tesla en la operación. Ver más: Avance demócrata en Texas pone bajo presión a Musk: Tesla y SpaceX pierden US$130.000 millones SpaceX y Tesla ya mantienen vínculos comerciales, entre los que se incluye una iniciativa conjunta para construir una planta de semiconductores en Texas denominada Terafab. Además, ambas empresas han ido sentando cada vez más las bases para llevar a cabo operaciones conjuntas. SpaceX, conocida oficialmente como Space Exploration Technologies Corp. y con sede en Starbase (Texas), salió a bolsa en junio en una cotización histórica en Nueva York que convirtió a Musk en el primer billonario del mundo. En los últimos años, la empresa se ha transformado, pasando de ser un fabricante líder de cohetes y proveedor de servicios de lanzamiento a un proveedor crucial de infraestructura de IA para empresas como Anthropic PBC, así como un proveedor líder de internet transmitido desde el espacio. US Treasury bought yen in July; Fed made no solo FX interventions in Q3

Banknotes of Japanese yen and U.S. dollar are seen in this illustration picture taken September 23, 2022. REUTERS/Florence Lo/Illustration

FAST

Nov 12 : The US Treasury bought Japanese yen in the July-to-September quarter, but the Federal Reserve did not intervene on its own in foreign exchange markets in the same period, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York said on Thursday. The New York Fed's quarterly report on currency market operations detailed interventions executed on behalf of the Treasury this summer to stem a sharp weakening of the yen. The purchase was the first US yen-buying intervention since 1998, and the report shows Washington acted alongside Tokyo to support the Japanese currency. On July 30, press reports emerged that the New York Fed had requested "rate checks" on the dollar-yen rate. The New York Fed report said the checks were made "solely on behalf of the US Treasury," with the New York Fed acting as the government's fiscal agent. The yen rose 2.3 per cent against the dollar that day.

A Reuters photograph taken during a cabinet meeting at Camp David on July 31 showed a "to-do" list in which Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent appeared to be weighing US purchases of $5 billion to $10 billion worth of Japanese yen. The New York Fed said it bought 79.4 billion yen ($497.37 million) in the spot market on July 31, selling euros from the Exchange Stabilization Fund. The New York Fed made the purchase "to counter what the US Treasury viewed as disorderly moves in the Japanese yen," its report said. Japan's Ministry of Finance acted in coordination, intervening "in the amount of 15.4 trillion yen" during the quarter to counter what it saw as excessive volatility and disorderly yen moves, the New York Fed added. Bessent said on August 2 that the US "will not hesitate to participate in further joint intervention," while repeating calls for further interest rate hikes by the Bank of Japan. The yen recovered quickly. Between July 30 and August 3, the dollar-yen rate fell "from around 164 yen per dollar to around 155 yen per dollar," the report said. The yen has since weakened. Japan's top currency diplomat, Atsushi Mimura, warned on Thursday that it was "too early to forget" this summer's intervention as the yen moved back toward 160 per dollar, its weakest level since September. Analysts at Mizuho Securities flagged the risk of Japanese intervention, saying the dollar was likely to keep rising against the yen, supported by resilience in the US economy and persistently high inflation driven by strong AI investment. Some Bank of Japan policymakers called in October for speeding up rate hikes, arguing that underlying inflation has reached the central bank's 2 per cent target. Their remarks strengthen the case for near-term tightening. A majority of economists in a Reuters poll expect the BOJ to raise its policy rate to 1.5 per cent in December, extending the faster pace after increases in June and September. ($1 = 159.6400 yen)

Source: Reuters

item.title: US stocks a tap away: How Indian trading apps are changing investment habits
item.description: Major Indian stockbroking apps began making it easier for retail investors to buy US stocks last month. Experts tell CNA the move could reshape investment habits as Indians seek global opportunities, but warn of risks and potential implications for domestic markets.
item.dc:creator: Shadma Shaikh
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Asia

US stocks a tap away: How Indian trading apps are changing investment habits

Major Indian stockbroking apps began making it easier for retail investors to buy US stocks last month. Experts tell CNA the move could reshape investment habits as Indians seek global opportunities, but warn of risks and potential implications for domestic markets.

A stock broker works at his trading terminal at an office in Mumbai, India, February 1, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Francis Mascarenhas)

FAST

BENGALURU: For  eight years, Bengaluru - based recruitment professional Jishnu Banerjee has invested in Indian stocks through online brokerage Zerodha. Now, the 40 - year - old is considering adding  shares in companies  based in the United States such as Apple and Meta to his portfolio. “It's good to have the option to diversify. It shouldn't matter whether the Indian market or the US market is doing better. I would want to diversify regardless,” he said.

Bengaluru-based recruitment professional Jishnu Banerjee, 40, is considering investing in US stocks through Zerodha to diversify his portfolio beyond Indian markets. (Photo: Jishnu Banerjee)

His interest comes as some of India's biggest stockbrokers make it easier for millions of existing customers to invest in US companies.

Three major Indian stockbrokers - Groww, Zerodha and Angel One - began rolling out services allowing customers to invest in US stocks in October.  Previously, Indian investors typically had to use specialist platforms to buy US stocks, with overseas money transfers often involving extra fees and delays.  The new services - introduced after Indian regulatory reforms in 2025 eased access to overseas markets - allow customers to invest through familiar apps, although currency-conversion costs and international transfer requirements remain. The growing interest in US stocks comes as Indian equities lag behind Wall Street, with India's benchmark Nifty 50 index falling nearly 12 per cent in the first ten months of 2026, while the US S&P 500 gained about 11 per cent.  Together, Groww and Zerodha accounted for nearly 44 per cent of active retail  user accounts on India's National Stock Exchange in September.  Harsh Jain, Groww’s co-founder and chief operating officer, told CNA that the launch reflected growing interest among Indian retail investors in global industries, including artificial intelligence, semiconductors, robotics and electric vehicles. He said American technology giants were among the most popular investments  Industry experts told CNA easier access could shift Indian savings overseas, potentially diverting money from domestic markets while exposing inexperienced investors to new risks. WHY INDIANS ARE LOOKING OVERSEAS The growing attraction of  US stocks reflects a shift in how Indian investors view opportunities beyond their home market. Until around 2024, when Indian equities were outperforming many overseas markets, investors largely sought international exposure to diversify their portfolios rather than earn higher returns, said Vishal Dhawan, founder of Mumbai-based wealth advisory firm Plan Ahead. “If you want high returns, you come to India. If you want diversification, you go overseas,” he said, describing the prevailing mindset at the time. But India's relative market underperformance since then, a weakening rupee and the boom in  US-based artificial intelligence companies have changed that calculation, he said. Dhawan said his firm had long advised many clients to keep around 20 per cent of their investments in overseas markets, spreading their money beyond Indian stocks. Previously, some questioned whether that allocation was dragging down their overall returns because Indian equities were performing better. Now, with overseas markets delivering stronger returns, some are asking whether 20  per cent is enough, he said. India's relatively limited exposure to AI-linked companies has also weighed on its stock market this year, Reuters reported on  Nov 4 , highlighting a gap that investors seeking to participate in the global AI boom may look overseas to fill.

Harsh Jain, co-founder and chief operating officer of online brokerage Groww (Photo: Harsh Jain)

More than half of investors who bought US securities through Groww have purchased at least one AI, big-tech or semiconductor stock, according to data shared by the company. “Some of the most popular US stocks include  Nvidia , SpaceX, Apple,  Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Micron, Tesla and Netflix,” said  Jain of Groww . He added that funds tracking major US stock indices, including the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100, were also among the most popular investments. The appeal is also extending beyond affluent investors, according to  Ashish Kashyap, founder of investment platform INDmoney. The company said the median first international investment on its platform was US$150, while systematic investment plans (SIPs) - which enable regular investments in smaller amounts in global stocks - nearly doubled between September 2025 and September 2026.

Traders work on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York City on Nov 10, 2026. (Photo: Angela Weiss/AFP)

“An investor may initially come to INDmoney to buy Nvidia, Google or Apple, but increasingly recognises the importance of building a diversified international portfolio rather than concentrating investments in a handful of companies, sectors or geographies,” Kashyap said. COULD INDIAN MARKETS LOSE OUT? The growing interest in overseas stocks comes at a time when foreign investors have been pulling money out of India's equity markets. Foreign  institutional investors pulled out a net 2.95 trillion  Indian rupees (about US$31 billion) from the  country’s stock markets in the first ten months of 2026, according to  a Press Trust of India report . Meanwhile, Indian residents invested US$2.61 billion in overseas stocks and debt instruments between January and August, up 86 per cent from a year earlier, according to  data from India’s central bank . The increase points to growing interest in foreign investments among Indians, even before major domestic brokerages launched their latest US stock investing services in October. Specialist platforms Vested and INDmoney have offered US stocks since 2019 and 2020 respectively, but the latest rollouts make overseas investing accessible through familiar brokerage apps. Groww itself offered US stocks in 2020 but halted new purchases in February 2024, citing transfer difficulties, high withdrawal fees and settlement delays. Investment platforms Groww and INDmoney said overseas investing is unlikely to replace domestic investments, with Kashyap suggesting it is “increasingly attracting incremental household savings” rather than diverting money from Indian equities. Customers typically start with less than 3 per cent of their portfolios invested overseas, raising that share to 7 to 10 per cent within eight to 12 months, according to INDmoney. However, wealth adviser Dhawan expects India's historically strong preference for domestic investments to gradually diminish as more investors diversify internationally. He said familiar brokerage platforms such as Groww and Zerodha could accelerate that shift by making investors more comfortable buying overseas shares. Nevertheless,  appetite for domestic investments remains strong.  For instance, telecom and digital services company Jio Platforms made its stock market debut on Oct 28 after raising about US$3.2 billion in India's largest-ever initial public offering (IPO). Its retail portion was oversubscribed 2.72 times, according to exchange data.

Indian billionaire and Reliance chairman Mukesh Ambani (C) and his wife Nita Ambani (2L) with their children and Jio Platforms board members Isha Ambani (L), Akash Ambani (2R) and Anant Ambani at Jio's IPO listing ceremony at the National Stock Exchange in Mumbai on Oct 28, 2026. (Photo: AFP/Indranil Mukherjee)

Growing overseas capital flows have also drawn regulatory scrutiny, with Bloomberg reporting on Oct 20 that India's central bank had stepped up checks on large overseas investments amid concerns over a weakening rupee. However, this is currently directed at companies, rather than individual retail investors.  THE RISKS OF CHASING WALL STREET Experts who spoke to CNA warned that easier access to  the US stock market could expose inexperienced Indian investors to unfamiliar risks, particularly if they are drawn to technology companies after their strong market performance. The risks were highlighted by a sharp sell-off in US technology stocks on Nov 5, which wiped about US$2.5 trillion off the Nasdaq-100's market value amid fears of tighter AI regulation and concerns over lofty valuations.  Nvidia shares had fallen nearly 29 per cent from their record high on Oct 6 by Nov 11, highlighting the risks for investors hoping to profit from the technology boom. Dhawan said investors might fall for “recency bias”, where they chase stocks that have recently delivered strong returns without considering whether those gains can continue. He said the social appeal of owning shares in famous companies such as Google or Amazon could also influence younger investors, even when they have limited understanding of the businesses. But Banerjee does not expect investing in familiar American companies to require much additional guidance. He said he would approach buying US shares much like investing in Indian stocks and did not expect brokerage platforms to provide extensive education for straightforward investments. Beyond market volatility, overseas investing brings complications that Indian investors may not encounter when buying domestic shares, Dhawan said.

Ashish Kashyap, founder of investment platform INDmoney (Photo: Ashish Kashyap)

For example, US estate taxes could apply to American shares owned by an Indian investor if they die, potentially reducing what their family inherits.  Dividends paid to shareholders may also be taxed in the US before investors receive them. Indian investors must also declare certain overseas holdings in their tax returns and account for currency-conversion fees and international money-transfer charges,  Dhawan said . These additional costs could eat into investment returns, particularly for those investing small amounts or trading frequently. Dhawan warned that the convenience of buying  US shares should not obscure the additional responsibilities that come with investing in another country. “Investors who fail to understand those obligations could end up creating problems for  themselves that they don't even understand,” he said.

Related:

India's NSE IPO draws over US$10 billion, traders eye modest listing pop

Nvidia selloff deepens, adding to AI jitters

Ambani’s Jio reaches US$137 billion valuation, becoming India’s second-most valuable firm

item.title: Russia Sets November 22 Start for Exchange Crypto Trading, Subject to Approval
item.description: TL;DR: Russian exchanges may begin cryptocurrency trading from November 22 if their trading rules receive the Bank of Russia’s concurrence. The November 11 announcement sets operating requirements for ...
item.content:encoded:
News / NewsBTC / Russia Sets November 22 Start for Exchange Crypto Trading, Subject to Approval

Russia Sets November 22 Start for Exchange Crypto Trading, Subject to Approval 3 min read

BTCUSD ETHUSD USDTUSD TL;DR: Russian exchanges may begin cryptocurrency trading from November 22 if their trading rules receive the Bank of Russia’s concurrence. The November 11 announcement sets operating requirements for venues. A separate asset-eligibility ordinance takes effect on November 17, so the two dates describe different regulatory steps. Russia has added another piece to its regulated crypto market framework, with a new ordinance setting the conditions under which exchanges can start trading digital currencies and digital rights. The Bank of Russia’s November 11 notice identifies November 22 as the earliest start under those rules, subject to the regulator agreeing to a venue’s trading arrangements. That condition matters. An effective date creates a legal opening; it does not show that every exchange is technically ready or that every prospective customer can place an order on the same morning. The exchange rulebook comes into focus Under the announcement, exchanges must register trading participants, maintain records of orders and transactions, and monitor trading. They also have to calculate specified prices and report trading information to the central bank using the procedures applied to other assets. These requirements address the organisation of a market: who participates, how activity is recorded and what the supervisor can inspect. The notice says the Ministry of Justice has registered the ordinance. It does not name a completed launch at a particular exchange or provide a forecast for trading volumes. Why November 17 is a different milestone The central bank’s November 6 asset-eligibility announcement set a November 17 effective date for an ordinance covering Bitcoin, Ether and USDT. That notice deals with which assets non-qualified investors may access and the conditions attached to their purchases. Non-qualified investors face an annual purchase ceiling of 300,000 rubles through a single intermediary. Qualified investors are not subject to that asset-list and purchase-limit restriction. The central bank says investors in both groups must pass the relevant test and familiarise themselves with crypto investment risks before transacting. Reading the announcements together avoids a misleading single-date headline. One concerns the eligible assets and investor conditions; the other concerns organised trading requirements. Neither removes the need to check when a particular intermediary actually makes a service available. Domestic permission and platform access differ A national regulatory opening can exist alongside changes at individual international exchanges. NewsBTC previously reported KuCoin’s withdrawal from Russia and Belarus, where affected users’ account notices determine their closure deadlines. Those developments should be assessed separately. A domestic venue’s permission does not change another company’s service terms, and an international exchange exit does not by itself tell us when a domestic alternative will be usable. For a trader, the practical questions include the identity of the intermediary, the assets it supports, how a purchase is funded and where holdings are kept. For an exchange, reliable records and price calculations become part of delivering a functioning service rather than merely announcing one. A new route does not measure new demand The market impact depends on participation after services open. An expanded route into Bitcoin could bring additional buyers, but it could also shift activity from one channel to another. Permission alone cannot distinguish those outcomes or establish how much fresh capital will arrive. There is a longer institutional backdrop. NewsBTC reported VTB’s conditional plans for direct crypto trading in December 2025. That historical proposal helps explain interest in domestic access, but it is not evidence that the bank has launched a service under the latest rules. The next meaningful evidence from Russia will be venue-specific launch notices, completed onboarding and observable trading activity. Until those arrive, November 22 is best understood as a conditional regulatory starting point. It is a material step toward an organised market, with implementation still determining what customers can actually do. written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（12日）米国株反落、ドル19カ月ぶり高値、利回り上昇 6:47 配信

＜為替＞ 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇し、約１９カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げ軌道を巡ってタカ派的な見方が強まり、投資家が米国債利回りを押し上げたことが背景。

ユーロは０．３２％安の１．１０５５ドルとなり、２０２５年４月以来の対ドル安値を付けた。

ドルは対スイスフランで０．２６％高の０．８３５フランと、１カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。

マネーコープのトレーディング・仕組み商品責任者、ユージーン・エプスタイン氏は「ドルはほぼ完全にＦＲＢ期待に基づいて上昇している」と述べた。その上で「ＦＦ金利先物を見ると、ここ数日のドルの動きとの相関はかなり高い。ＦＦ金利先物自体が高水準にあるのは、消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回ったことに加え、多数のＦＲＢ関係者からタカ派的な発言が相次いだためだ」と語った。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、投資家は現在、１２月のＦＲＢ利上げ確率を約８５％織り込んでいる。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 米金融・債券市場では、国債利回りが上昇した。トランプ米大統領によるイランとの合意は不要だとの発言や、来月の連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による利上げ幅が通常より大きくなる可能性を見極める展開となった。

トランプ大統領はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で「われわれにイランとの合意は必要ない。そうした時代はとうに過ぎ去った。われわれは彼らの資金、数千億ドルを押さえており、（ホルムズ）海峡も掌握している！」と述べた。

ミシュラー・フィナンシャル・グループのマネジングディレクター、トム・ディガロマ氏は「基本的に、トランプ氏はこの停戦合意が成立する可能性は低いと感じている」と指摘。「ポートフォリオマネジャーたちが考えているのは、米国が今週末にさらなる攻撃を準備しているということだ」と述べた。

クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は、インフレ抑制には短期金利の引き上げが依然として必要であるとの見解を示し、「私の見解では、小幅な利上げをより頻繁に、段階的に進める方が、企業や家計にとって対応しやすい」との見方を示した。

サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁は、高止まりするインフレに対応するため、ＦＲＢは追加利上げが必要になる可能性が高いとの見方を示した。ただ、判断を急ぐべきだとは示唆しなかった。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 米国株式市場は反落して取引を終えた。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の退任を受けたエヌビディア株の下落が、エネルギー株の上昇を相殺した。

エヌビディアは４．３％下落した。ただ、一時１２％近く下げた後、この日の安値からは大きく戻した。バンダ・アナリティクスのデータによると、個人投資家は取引開始から３０分間に同社株を約１億１１００万ドル購入。この時間帯の買い付け額として過去最大を記録した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００エネルギー株指数は１．５％上昇。４営業日続伸し、Ｓ＆Ｐ主要１１セクターで最大の上昇率となった。トランプ米大統領が、米国はイランとの合意を必要としていないとソーシャルメディアに投稿したことを受け、原油価格が上昇した。

世界的に人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が下落し、ＡＩクラウド企業ネビウスは四半期決算と業績見通しの発表後に１６．８％急落。１日の下落率として７月１日以来の大きさとなった。 一方、エヌビディアと競合するブロードコム、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイシズ（ＡＭＤ）、アルファベット、アマゾン・ドット・コムなどは上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主な押し上げ要因となった。

株式相場はここ数日、不安定な値動きが続いている。米中間選挙で民主党が大勝したことで、ＡＩ規制の強化に対する投資家の懸念が浮上。エヌビディアの経営体制を巡る不安も、現在の強気相場を支える柱の一つに重しとなっている。同社はコレット・クレス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）を暫定ＣＥＯに指名した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 金は３％下落し、約１年ぶりの安値を付けた。中東和平への期待が後退し原油価格が上昇、インフレ再燃と金利上昇への懸念が広がった。

１８５５ＧＭＴ（日本時間１３日午前３時５５分）現在、金現物は２．７％下落し１オンス＝３８８０．９３ドル。一時は２０２５年１０月以来の安値を付ける場面もあった。中心限月１２月物の清算値（終値に相当）は２．９％安の１オンス＝３８８５．３０ドル。

トランプ米大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）で、米国はイランとの合意を必要としないと述べ、紛争終結に向けた合意への期待に水を差した。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 米国時間の原油先物は大幅高となり、北海ブレント先物が１バレル当たり約３ドル上昇して取引を終えた。サウジアラビアのエネルギー施設への攻撃が激化したほか、ホルムズ海峡の海運の混乱が世界の石油供給を脅かした。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が３．０６ドル（３．３％）高の１バレル＝９５．８２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．２１ドル（２．６％）高の８８．７４ドルだった。

ただ、週間では両指標ともなお約２．５％下落している。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: ＭＳ障害続く、アウトルックなど利用不能 ＡＩサービスにも影響
item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフト（ＭＳ）のクラウドサービス「Ｍｉｃｒｏｓｏｆｔ
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１２日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフト（ＭＳ）のクラウドサービス「Ｍｉｃｒｏｓｏｆｔ ３６５」や電子メールサービス「アウトルック」、ビジネス向けチャットツール「チームズ」などで１２日、大規模な通信障害が発生した。障害は５時間以上続いており、多数の利用者に影響が出ている。人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩやアンソロピックのＡＩサービスが使用するコネクターにも影響を及ぼした。

マイクロソフトは米東部時間午後６時（日本時間１３日午前８時）時点で、影響を受けたサーバーの復旧作業を続けており、利用者が徐々に再接続する中、一部で回復が見られたと説明した。障害追跡サイト「ダウンディテクター」によると、アウトルックに関する不具合の報告は米東部時間午後１時ごろに１３万８０５８件でピークを付け、夕方には約３万４４９０件に減少した。

マイクロソフトは同日これに先立ち、障害の原因は通信量の増加ではなく、高負荷に対して予期せず利用不能となったサーバーが複数あったためだと説明していた。

ダウンディテクターによると、米東部時間午後５時４７分までに、Ｍｉｃｒｏｓｏｆｔ ３６５に関する不具合の報告は約１万３０００件に減少。チームズへのアクセスに関する報告は７６３件だった。

マイクロソフトはその後、復旧したサーバーはこれまでのところ安定していると説明。可能な限り通信を別の経路に切り替えるとともに、影響が残るサーバーの復旧手順を効率化しているとした。

同社は声明で「容量の復旧に伴い、ユーザーのクライアントが再接続するにつれて、サービスは段階的に回復していく可能性がある」と説明した。

＜企業活動にも影響＞

オープンＡＩは、マイクロソフトのコネクターで新規接続が機能しなくなる可能性があり、ツールが想定通りに動作しない問題を調査していると明らかにした。

アンソロピックは、Ｍｉｃｒｏｓｏｆｔ ３６５のコネクターに影響を及ぼす問題を、接続先のサービス提供事業者で確認したと説明した。

マイクロソフトは先月にもクラウド基盤「アジュール」の障害を報告していた。この障害は同社の業務用ソフトウエア群や、世界の幅広い業種に影響を及ぼした。

item.title: World shares are mixed as Nvidia's troubles weigh on AI stocks
item.description: World shares were mixed on Thursday as concerns over leadership at chipmaker Nvidia weighed on artificial intelligence-related stocks.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
item.content:encoded: NEW YORK — The U.S. stock market shook Thursday, but it largely absorbed big swings for Nvidia and oil prices and finished with relatively modest losses. The moves suggested Wall Street sees limited fallout for the artificial intelligence industry, which carries immense influence on the market, despite the sudden fall of one of its biggest evangelists. After dropping nearly one per cent at the start of trading, the S&P 500 quickly erased all of the loss before finishing with a dip of 0.4 per cent. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 189 points, or 0.4 per cent, while the Nasdaq composite sank 0.4 per cent after trimming an early drop of 1.6 per cent. Stocks broadly felt pressure from a rise in oil prices after U.S. President Donald Trump said he’s no longer interested in a deal with Iran to end their war. Instead of that, Trump said he asked his vice president to investigate U.S. cities and states run by Democrats. On a typical day, that could be the main driver of action on Wall Street. But little has been typical recently for the yo-yoing stock market. The focus instead was on Nvidia’s stock. It plunged 14 per cent at the start of trading following the resignation of Jensen Huang, its CEO, co-founder and face of the brand. The chip company’s stock has been sinking since its board announced an investigation into Huang for a relationship with a woman suspected of being a Chinese government agent. It’s a stunning fall for Huang and for Nvidia, which had become Wall Street’s most valuable and influential stock because of its central role in the AI boom. Its stock price set a record last month after soaring an astounding 1,722 per cent in four years. That compares with the already healthy gain of nearly 109 per cent for the overall S&P 500 over the same time. But Nvidia’s price dropped 27 per cent from then through Wednesday. At first, the drop was because of worries about too-high prices for stocks across the AI industry. More recently, it’s been due to worries about whether Huang would remain as CEO and how Nvidia would navigate a future without him. Nvidia’s board answered the first question Thursday morning, when it said Huang resigned, and it named Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as its interim CEO. The second question remains unanswered. And it looms over the entire market because Nvidia and the broader AI industry have been the main reasons the U.S. stock market has set so many records in recent years. Nvidia, to be sure, is still selling AI chips at a quick rate regardless of who stands on a stage and talks them up, and analysts said it remains the industry’s leader. That helped Nvidia quickly halve its early loss Thursday, and its stock finished with a fall of 4.3 per cent. That paring helped the broader market to recover. Outside of Nvidia, stocks across the AI industry swung in the uncertainty. CoreWeave, which buys Nvidia chips and then rents out access to them to customers over the cloud, fell 6.9 per cent. Micron Technology, which sells memory for computers that’s been getting gobbled up in the AI frenzy, sank 1.6 per cent. But Broadcom rose 5.5 per cent, and Advanced Micro Devices added 5.9 per cent on hopes the rival chip companies will gain a competitive advantage. Those two gains came close to offsetting the drop for Nvidia, which was the single heaviest weight on the S&P 500. That suggests investors see the AI business expanding to other players rather than depending solely on Nvidia. Also helping to limit the U.S. market’s losses were gains for stocks in the oil and gas industry. Marathon Petroleum climbed 2.5 per cent, and ExxonMobil added 1.8 per cent. They benefited from a rise in oil prices after Trump said on his social media platform, “We don’t need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed. We’ve got their money, Hundreds of Billions of Dollars, and we’ve got their Strait!” The price for a barrel of Brent crude climbed 3.3 per cent to US$95.82. The price for the most actively traded contract in the Brent market has been veering sharply since the United States and Israel began the war with Iran in late February, bouncing between roughly US$70 and US$120. Higher oil prices push up worries about inflation, and the yield on the 10-year Treasury jumped to 5.12 per cent from 4.98 per cent late Tuesday. Trading in the bond market had been closed Wednesday for Veterans Day. Higher yields make borrowing money more expensive for everyone, from the U.S. government to companies building AI data centres to regular people buying houses. High mortgage rates helped send sales of previously occupied U.S. homes in October to their slowest pace in more than 16 years. The housing industry has been slowing the U.S. economy but not upending it. A separate report on Thursday said that slightly more U.S. workers applied for unemployment benefits last week, but the number remains relatively low compared with history. All told, the S&P 500 fell 26.98 points to 7,592.40. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped 189.40 to 52,297.09, and the Nasdaq composite sank 100.10 to 25,366.09. In stock markets abroad, indexes were mixed in Europe following a weaker finish in Asia. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng fell 1.3 per cent for one of the world’s biggest moves. ___ Stan Choe, The Associated Press AP Business Writer Yuri Kageyama contributed to this report.

item.description: ［ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇し、約１９カ月ぶりの...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル19カ月ぶり高値、利上げ観測で　円は9月来の安値 6:28 配信

2015年12月16日、ワシントンの米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ） REUTERS/Kevin Lamarque/File Photo（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　１２日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇し、約１９カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げ軌道を巡ってタカ派的な見方が強まり、投資家が米国債利回りを押し上げたことが背景。

ユーロは０．３２％安の１．１０５５ドルとなり、２０２５年４月以来の対ドル安値を付けた。

ドルは対スイスフランで０．２６％高の０．８３５フランと、１カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。

マネーコープのトレーディング・仕組み商品責任者、ユージーン・エプスタイン氏は「ドルはほぼ完全にＦＲＢ期待に基づいて上昇している」と述べた。その上で「ＦＦ金利先物を見ると、ここ数日のドルの動きとの相関はかなり高い。ＦＦ金利先物自体が高水準にあるのは、消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回ったことに加え、多数のＦＲＢ関係者からタカ派的な発言が相次いだためだ」と語った。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、投資家は現在、１２月のＦＲＢ利上げ確率を約８５％織り込んでいる。

ドル指数は０．２９％高の１０３．１７となり、２０２５年４月以来の高値圏にある。

円は対ドルで０．１３％安の１ドル＝１５９．９７５円となり、９月以来の安値を付けた。

ゴールドマン・サックスのアナリストは「今週の円全般の下落は主にドル側の動きによるものだが、貿易加重ベースでは、円は現在、１月と９月に報じられたレートチェック前よりも弱い水準にある」と指摘した。その上で「同時に、実際の介入が行われる今年の実現しきい値はさらに遠い。貿易加重ベースの円は、４月末の財務省による介入前と比べて依然としてほぼ１％高く、７月末に始まった協調介入前と比べても約２．６％高い」と述べた。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 159.85/159.87

始値 159.67

高値 160.04

安値 159.53

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1053/1.1056

始値 1.1092

高値 1.1098

安値 1.1046

FAST

Nov 12 : Anthropic's initial public offering has drawn about six times the orders for the shares available for what could be the largest first-time share sale, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday. Bankers told prospective investors that Anthropic will prioritize its existing backers, leaving some would-be buyers with smaller allocations than expected, the report added, citing people familiar with the matter. Details of the IPO, including the demand for shares, could change, according to the report. Anthropic could not immediately be reached for comment on the report. Anthropic's initial public offering will value the Claude chatbot creator at up to $1.4 trillion, slightly below some investor expectations, setting up a key test of Wall Street's confidence in the artificial intelligence boom. The AI lab and some of its existing shareholders are aiming to raise up to $64.4 billion in the IPO by selling 825 million shares priced between $70 and $78 each. Shares are expected to start trading on the Nasdaq on November 19 under the symbol "ANT."

Source: Reuters

item.description:
Chuck Mikolajczak
［ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は反落して取引を終えた。ジェン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝反落、エヌビディア株の下落がエネルギー株高を相殺 6:22 配信

米ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）で11月10日撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） Chuck Mikolajczak

［ニューヨーク　１２日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は反落して取引を終えた。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の退任を受けたエヌビディア株の下落が、エネルギー株の上昇を相殺した。

エヌビディアは４．３％下落した。ただ、一時１２％近く下げた後、この日の安値からは大きく戻した。バンダ・アナリティクスのデータによると、個人投資家は取引開始から３０分間に同社株を約１億１１００万ドル購入。この時間帯の買い付け額として過去最大を記録した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００エネルギー株指数は１．５％上昇。４営業日続伸し、Ｓ＆Ｐ主要１１セクターで最大の上昇率となった。トランプ米大統領が、米国はイランとの合意を必要としていないとソーシャルメディアに投稿したことを受け、原油価格が上昇した。

世界的に人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が下落し、ＡＩクラウド企業ネビウスは四半期決算と業績見通しの発表後に１６．８％急落。１日の下落率として７月１日以来の大きさとなった。 一方、エヌビディアと競合するブロードコム、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイシズ（ＡＭＤ）、アルファベット、アマゾン・ドット・コムなどは上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主な押し上げ要因となった。

株式相場はここ数日、不安定な値動きが続いている。米中間選挙で民主党が大勝したことで、ＡＩ規制の強化に対する投資家の懸念が浮上。エヌビディアの経営体制を巡る不安も、現在の強気相場を支える柱の一つに重しとなっている。同社はコレット・クレス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）を暫定ＣＥＯに指名した。

アージェント・キャピタル・マネジメントのポートフォリオマネジャー、ジェド・エラーブルック氏は「市場では今、ＡＩ株やハイテク株を売り、安全な銘柄を買う動きが出ている。今年の１─２月に最初に見られた動きと同じだが、いずれ逆転するだろう」と指摘。「市場ではこうした綱引きが起きている。成長鈍化への懸念がある一方、バリュエーションの絶対水準と成長率は依然としてかなり魅力的だという見方がある」と語った。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は０．５％下落した。それまでの４営業日で１７．２％急騰していた。

ネビウスに加え、同業のコアウィーブも６．９％下落。データセンター関連企業のＩＲＥＮとアプライド・デジタルはそれぞれ６．５％、５．４％下落した。

投資家は１３日発表の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）を待っている。今週これまでに発表された消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は予想を上回る伸びとなった。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を３．４対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも３．１８対１で値下がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１９１億８０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１８６億１０００万株。

item.title: ＦＲＢ、27年の会合日程発表 金利決定の回数8回から7回に
item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は１２日、２０２７年の金融政策会合の更新版の日程を公表した。ウォー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ、27年の会合日程発表　金利決定の回数8回から7回に 6:19 配信

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）ビル。2020年5月撮影。REUTERS/Kevin Lamarque（ロイター） [１２日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は１２日、２０２７年の金融政策会合の更新版の日程を公表した。ウォーシュ議長は先月、政策担当者が金利について討議・採決する回数を、慣例となっていた年８回から２７年は７回に減らすと発表していた。

ＦＲＢは声明で、政策担当者は依然として連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）を年８回開催するものの、２７年１０月２６─２７日に予定される同会合は「広範な金融政策戦略を巡る課題の議論に充てられる」と説明した。

同年最後の会合は、当初予定されていた１２月７─８日ではなく１１月１６─１７日に開催され、これは政策金利を決定する会合となる。その後、ウォーシュ氏の先月の発表に沿って、政策担当者は２８年１月２５─２６日まで会合を開かない。

ウォーシュ氏は１０月２８日の記者会見で、「２８年は戦略の議論に充てる会合が２回、政策決定のための会合が６回になると見込んでいる」と説明した。このペースであれば、政策担当者は会合の合間に２カ月分の経済指標を評価することが可能になる。

ＦＲＢの政策会合を一覧にした更新版のページでは、２７年３月、６月、９月の会合について、政策担当者が四半期経済見通しを提出する会合であることを示すアスタリスクの表記が削除された。同氏は５月にＦＲＢ議長に就任して以来、自身の見通しを一度も提出していない。

同氏はＦＲＢの情報発信の慣行と戦略を見直すタスクフォース（作業部会）を設置した。これには、政策担当者の見通しを示す「ドットチャート」の公表を続けるかどうかも含まれる。

SAO PAULO, Nov 12 : Brazilian digital lender Nubank posted third-quarter profit in line with analysts' estimates on Thursday, while improving its efficiency ratio projections for the year partly due to an artificial intelligence-led slowdown in hiring. Nubank parent Nu Holdings, which has over 140 million clients and in September began expanding beyond Latin America, now expects its full-year efficiency ratio, which measures how much a bank has to spend to generate revenue, to land between 19 per cent and 19.5 per cent, below a previous expectation of around 20 per cent. "The biggest thing is that our pace of hiring was a little bit slower than we expected," Chief Financial Officer Rob Livingston told Reuters. "We are seeing significant benefits from AI helping us with our capacity and productivity, and so we slowed down our hiring."  Livingston said Nubank's return-to-office policy, announced last year, was also rolling out more slowly than initially planned as the company is opening new offices in several cities, while stronger-than-expected revenue also boosted efficiency prospects.

PROFIT MATCHES ESTIMATES, SHARES UP Nubank reported $1.09 billion in net income for the July-September quarter, up 31 per cent from a year earlier on a currency-neutral basis and matching the Visible Alpha consensus. Revenue also came in roughly in line with market expectations at $6.26 billion, a 37 per cent boost.  Shares of the company were up around 4 per cent in extended trading following the results, after rising 2 per cent during the earnings conference call.  Nubank's credit portfolio grew by 33 per cent, while the 90-day delinquency ratio rose to 7.3 per cent from 6.7 per cent, a climb Livingston  attributed mostly to seasonal effects and an increase in risk between late last year and early this year. "We're not seeing any evidence of broad-based exogenous worsening in our portfolio," he said. "The increase is entirely due to management decisions and timing that we were anticipating," he noted. HIGH BAR ON ACQUISITIONS Nubank Chief Executive David Velez said in a call with analysts that the bank will look at potential mergers or acquisitions as it expands globally, but that it has a "strong preference" for organic growth. "The bar would have to be extremely high for us to do a full M&A," Velez said. The remarks came after media reports in September that Nubank was in talks to buy British digital bank Monzo in a £10 billion ($13.23 billion) deal, which sent Nubank shares lower at the time as investors pointed to the transaction's execution risk. Nubank said a few days later that it was not pursuing such a transaction. ($1 = 0.7556 pound)

FAST

Nov 12 : Kalshi is in talks to raise fresh funds at a $65 billion valuation to build a new platform for trading compute futures, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Thursday, days after announcing the finalization of its previous round. Kalshi could not immediately be reached for comment. The company raised $1 billion in a new funding round late last month amid efforts to expand beyond event contracts and compete more directly with traditional exchanges. The round was co-led by Sequoia and Wellington. The October fundraise came just over five months after Kalshi raised $1 billion in a Coatue-led round that valued the company at $22 billion.

RACE FOR COMPUTE FUTURES The move into compute futures would also be a part of the broader strategy of the prediction market startup in its venture into newer products, as it challenges the likes of CME Group and New York Stock Exchange parent Intercontinental Exchange. Compute futures are financial contracts allowing traders to hedge or speculate on the future prices of computing resources like cloud and GPU capacity. The derivatives help companies manage price volatility, lock in future processing power and cut costs in a fast-growing technology market. CME Group said earlier in the year that it was partnering with Silicon Data to launch compute futures later this year, pending regulatory review. ICE and Kalshi were also in the running for such products as Wall Street's push deepens for a derivative market for compute. "America cannot win the AI race without a robust derivatives market for compute," Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chairman Michael Selig said in a statement earlier in the year while calling for industry comments on such products. However, reports earlier in the week said that the regulator has postponed the approval of futures contracts tied to the rental price of graphics processing units as it plans to consult benchmark providers on price manipulation concerns in this nascent asset class.

FAST

Nov 12 : Cisco beat Wall Street estimates for first-quarter results and raised its annual revenue forecast on Thursday, as the network-gear maker bets on sustained strong demand from companies building out their AI infrastructure. The company has doubled down on its AI efforts through strategic investments as Big Tech's massive spending moves beyond AI processors to the switches and routers required to connect large data-center systems. Cisco expects fiscal 2027 revenue in the range of $74.8 billion to $75.8 billion, compared with its previous forecast of $72.2 billion to $73.4 billion. "We are in the very early stages of a multi-year networking supercycle," CEO Chuck Robbins said in a statement.

The company raised its fiscal 2027 forecast for AI infrastructure revenue from hyperscalers to $9 billion from $7.5 billion. The segment generated revenue of $4 billion a year earlier. Investors have been worried about a possible slowdown in data-center buildout following Democrats' sweeping win in the US midterms, as well as rising borrowing costs and their impact on the debt-fueled construction. Cisco reported first-quarter revenue of $18.5 billion, compared with analysts' average estimate of $18.14 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. The company reported an adjusted profit of $1.40 per share for the quarter ended October 24, above estimates of $1.33. Cisco is also building software tools that businesses can use to build their own armies of bots, known as AI agents, to protect their IT infrastructure against cybersecurity threats. Shares of the San Jose, California-based company were flat in volatile extended trading. They have risen about 32 per cent so far this year through Thursday's close. Cisco's gross margin has been a worry for investors, as a shortage of memory chips has pushed up component costs for hardware makers while suppliers prioritize chips for AI data-center customers. "A small dip in gross margin is not a major concern given higher memory and component costs," said Bob O'Donnell, president and chief analyst at TECHnalysis Research. Cisco's raised annual forecast and results above estimates are what the market wants to see from a company tied to AI infrastructure, he added. The company reported first-quarter adjusted gross margin of 65.6 per cent, in line with estimates, but down from 68.1 per cent a year earlier.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 12 : Cerebras Systems raised its 2026 revenue forecast and signed Microsoft as a customer, easing investor concerns about AI spending and sending the chip and cloud company's shares more than 17 per cent higher in extended trading on Thursday. The forecast signaled enduring demand for AI computing despite concerns driven by US voter opposition to data centers and uncertainty from Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia. The stock had fallen 47.2 per cent from its May IPO price as investors grew wary of the massive infrastructure spending required to support AI growth. "As we look to the months ahead, we see two certainties: rapid change and compute shortages," Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman said on a call with analysts. He said Cerebras' job is to make sure it grows no matter how AI develops, whether customers want hardware or cloud capacity.

Cerebras is racing to support a deal to provide computing power for OpenAI, which underpins Cerebras' remaining performance obligations of $26.1 billion as of September 30. Feldman also said the company has signed a cloud deal with Microsoft, with details to be shared next year. Cerebras now expects 2026 adjusted revenue of $940 million to $960 million, up from its previous expectations of $880 million to $890 million. Its adjusted cloud and services revenue, which reflects the OpenAI deal, more than tripled to $144.9 million for the third quarter. The chip firm posted an adjusted profit of $29.82 million in the third quarter, compared with an adjusted loss of $10.86 million a year earlier. Analysts, on average, had expected an adjusted loss of $38.4 million, according to data compiled by LSEG. Third-quarter adjusted sales rose 70 per cent to $230.9 million, beating analysts' average estimate of $214.70 million. In July, Cerebras announced a partnership with AMD to combine AMD's Helios systems with its wafer-scale engine for inference. Feldman said its cloud now uses AMD graphics processors for prompt processing. Cerebras' dinner-plate-sized WSE packs trillions of transistors on a single semiconductor and keeps memory on-chip, which it says is more efficient than linking many smaller GPUs that rely on costly high-bandwidth memory. Last month, Oracle expanded its cloud AI chip deals to add offerings from Cerebras. Feldman said the hardware will run in Oracle data centers, with the inference service expected to launch in summer 2027. He also said OpenAI's business with Cerebras grew from the second quarter, but that Cerebras lacked the capacity to support a broad rollout of OpenAI's Ultrafast, a faster service tier the AI firm previewed in August for its GPT-5.6 Sol model. He said data center availability remains a constraint across the industry and that US policy changes could create greater challenges for development.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Would a Tesla–SpaceX Merger Be Bullish for Bitcoin? Careful What You Wish For
item.description: As speculation about a possible Tesla-SpaceX merger continues to bubble, cryptocurrency market observers are asking a crucial question: could it drain liquidity from Bitcoin CRYPTO:BTCUSD the way ...
item.content:encoded:
News / Benzinga / Would a Tesla–SpaceX Merger Be Bullish for Bitcoin? Careful What You Wish For

Would a Tesla–SpaceX Merger Be Bullish for Bitcoin? Careful What You Wish For 2 min read

BTCUSD SPCX TSLA BTCUSD As speculation about a possible Tesla-SpaceX merger continues to bubble, cryptocurrency market observers are asking a crucial question: could it drain liquidity from Bitcoin BTCUSD the way SpaceX’s SPCX IPO once did? A Merger Wouldn’t Trigger the Same Bitcoin Selling an IPO Did Benzinga reported in October how analyst Benjamin Cowen previously linked Bitcoin’s weakness ahead of SpaceX’s IPO to softness before Anthropic’s expected listing. His theory: investors were holding back capital for the next big offering. GSR’s Spencer Hallarn made a similar point to Reuters in June, saying "crypto is a funding currency for a lot of this" as investors weighed SpaceX’s planned $75 billion raise. A merger would work differently from an IPO, since RBC’s hypothetical all-stock model has Tesla TSLA shareholders simply swapping their shares for SpaceX shares and no cash required. With nothing to buy, there’s no reason for investors to sell Bitcoin to fund it. SpaceX and Tesla’s Combined Bitcoin Stash Isn’t the Risk It Looks Like Tesla’s latest quarterly filing confirms an independent committee is exploring a closer relationship with SpaceX, including a possible business combination, though the company cautions no deal is assured. Here’s what the two companies actually hold in Bitcoin: SpaceX: 18,712 BTC, unchanged since December 2025 Tesla: 11,509 BTC, also unchanged Combined: 30,221 BTC, worth $2.53 billion at Bitcoin’s September 30 close of $83,553.85, now worth roughly $2.16 billion, a $370 million decline That drop has nothing to do with a merger. It’s just Bitcoin’s price falling since the quarter closed. SpaceX spent $48.07 billion on property and equipment over the first nine months against $13.10 billion in operating cash flow, a gap that might suggest pressure to raise cash. But the company still held $89.86 billion in cash and securities at quarter-end, which undercuts any theory that capex spending alone would force SpaceX to sell its Bitcoin. Meanwhile, Polymarket currently prices a formal merger announcement at 54% by June 30, 2027, and 68% by year-end 2027. Could Huang Joining SpaceX Be Bullish for Bitcoin? Not Yet Elon Musk replied it “would be an honor" to a ZeroHedge post urging him to hire Jensen Huang , with Polymarket traders now pricing roughly 8% to 10% odds Huang joins SpaceX by year-end. If that hire happened, it could arguably be a modest bullish signal for Bitcoin specifically, since SpaceX already holds 18,712 BTC on its balance sheet and adding a high-profile AI leader could reinforce investor confidence in the company managing that treasury alongside its broader business. That theory didn’t play out Thursday, though as SpaceX shares rose about 2%, while Bitcoin fell roughly 3% alongside the broader AI and chip stock selloff. The split shows Bitcoin and SpaceX stock barely move each other right now, since the $2.2 billion crypto holding is a rounding error against a company worth well over $1.5 trillion. FAST

Nov 12 : By one of Wall Street’s favorite metrics, Nvidia shares look like a bargain. Following a steep drop from its October 6 record high, Nvidia’s stock is trading at the equivalent of 12 times expected earnings. That’s its lowest valuation since 2012, when the chipmaker was competing with Advanced Micro Devices to dominate the market for videogame graphics cards while struggling to find a foothold in tablets and other mobile devices. The stock was down more than 5 per cent on Thursday after CEO Jensen Huang resigned, and is down about 12 per cent this week amid a scandal over reports of his extramarital affairs, including one with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress is taking over as interim CEO as Nvidia looks for a permanent successor.

But concern about leadership is not the only thing that has troubled investors. Nvidia, whose GPUs have fueled the AI boom, is now down over 30 per cent from its record, in large part due to worries about a potential slowdown in the buildout of AI data centers. "This is a key-person event, not a demand event. Nobody is canceling GPU orders because the CEO resigned. Historically, stocks take time to find a bottom after an abrupt CEO exit while the market works through the investigations and the search," said Erik Kratz, co-head of wealth and chief investment officer at Arena Private Wealth in Chicago. Nvidia reports quarterly earnings on Tuesday, with investors watching whether its sharp growth can survive without Huang. Investors favor stocks with low price-to-earnings ratios, or PEs, but a low multiple can also reflect doubts that expected earnings will materialize. While Nvidia’s share price has slumped in recent weeks, analysts so far have maintained forecasts for strong profit growth, expecting demand for Nvidia’s chips to continue to outpace supply. That could change after Nvidia posts its quarterly results. Analysts on average expect Nvidia to report a 92 per cent surge in October-quarter revenue and a net profit of over $60 billion, an 89 per cent increase, year over year, according to LSEG data. Investors will be keen to hear what Kress says about Nvidia’s outlook, which may matter even more than the results themselves.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 〔アングル〕ＡＩ企業、元「スパイ」採用活発化 エヌビディア問題でリスク認識
item.description:
Toby Sterling
[アムステルダム １２日 ロイター] - 偶然のように見えるスポーツジムやカフェでの出会い...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
〔アングル〕ＡＩ企業、元「スパイ」採用活発化　エヌビディア問題でリスク認識 5:48 配信

2026年11月12日、米国カリフォルニア州サンタクララにあるエヌビディア本社。 REUTERS/Manuel Orbegozo（ロイター） Toby Sterling

[アムステルダム １２日 ロイター] - 偶然のように見えるスポーツジムやカフェでの出会いに要注意──。急成長する人工知能（ＡＩ）関連などのハイテク企業が、スパイ活動対策などの危機対応を強化しており、元「スパイ」など情報専門家の採用が活発化している。

採用動向を追跡する会社によると、ここ数年、米ＡＩ開発大手のオープンＡＩやアンソロピック、米半導体大手エヌビディアなどが相次いで募集しており、給与は２０万─５０万ドル程度が多いという。

エヌビディアは１２日、中国のスパイとの疑惑が持たれている女性や社内幹部との不倫行為が明らかになったジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の辞任を発表した。

米シークレットサービス（大統領警護隊）を務めたことがある危機管理会社の幹部は「ＡＩ関連企業はセキュリティー人材を競って獲得している」と述べた。政府機関出身の非常に高度なスキルを持つ人材が企業のセキュリティーを担当するようになっており「豊富な経験を持つ人材の供給が、需要に追い付かない状況だ」という。

セキュリティー企業に勤務する米中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）元職員は、情報専門家が高く評価されるのは、従業員による企業秘密の窃取や、脅迫などによる脆弱性の悪用といった脅威を見抜く能力があるためだと説明。偶然のように見える出会いにも、実際にはスパイが企業トップらと親交を結んだり、脅したり、組織に引き込もうとしたりする試みの可能性があるという。

オープンＡＩは２０２４年６月、元国家安全保障局（ＮＳＡ）幹部を取締役会と安全関連の委員会に任命。アンソロピックは、２５年発足の国家安全保障関連の会議にＣＩＡ経験者などを迎え入れた。トップレベルの企業のセキュリティー責任者の年収は１００万─４００万ドルになることもある。

サイバーセキュリティー関連事業を率いる幹部は、企業のセキュリティー責任者の優先課題は、ＡＩを活用したハッキングへの対策とデータ保護の必要性だと指摘した。このため、経営陣がスパイの標的になるリスクは「現実離れしている」として関心が薄く、十分に検討されないケースが多いとされる。同幹部は「私の知る多くの企業、９０％と言っていいが、このリスクを完全に無視している。話を持ち出すと、皆の頭の中ですぐにジェームズ・ボンドのテーマ曲が流れ始めるからだ」と述べた。

世界的な「地政学上の競争」を踏まえると、大手ＡＩ企業も今や明白な標的だ。

専門人材紹介会社ＳＩプレースメントの創業者、キャシー・ラビンダー氏は、人員が十分にそろったチームでも、問題を常に回避できるわけではなく、経営トップの私生活を指図することもできないと指摘した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：中国「独身の日」、ＡＩが買い物主導　消費喚起なるかは未知数 アングル：米債券市場、ＡＩ関連債への熱冷める　政策瀬踏みムードに アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 アングル：世界市場は既にぜい弱、ＡＩにもひび割れ 11/13(金) 5:48 最終更新 ロイター

Nov 12 : SpaceX and Tesla are progressing in their merger negotiations and a deal could be announced as early as December, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter. The Elon Musk-led companies have also discussed a scenario in which the announcement slips into early 2027, the report said. SpaceX and Tesla could not be immediately reached for comment on the report. The proposed merger, which Musk last month called a "good idea", would unify his AI, robotics, EV and aerospace ambitions under a single corporate roof.

item.content:encoded:
News / Stock Story / Calumet, Gevo, Northern Oil and Gas, Borr Drilling, and TETRA Technologies shares skyrocket, what you need to know

Calumet, Gevo, Northern Oil and Gas, Borr Drilling, and TETRA Technologies shares skyrocket, what you need to know 2 min read

GEVO CL1! UKOIL

What happened? A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after President Donald Trump indicated he is no longer interested in reaching a deal with Iran to conclude their war, triggering a sharp jump in crude oil prices and renewed inflation concerns. The sudden escalation in geopolitical tensions between the United States and Iran raised immediate fears of potential supply disruptions across global energy markets. Iran is a prominent oil producer, and escalating friction threatens key regional shipping routes and production infrastructure. As benchmark crude prices climbed rapidly on the announcement, energy companies saw increased investor demand, given that higher commodity prices directly lift revenues and cash flows for oil exploration and production firms. At the same time, the price spike reignited inflation concerns on Wall Street, prompting benchmark bond yields to move higher as investors weighed the risk of persistent price pressures throughout the broader economy. While broader equity indexes ultimately stabilized after digesting the swings, energy equities benefited significantly from the surge in oil prices sparked by the deteriorating diplomatic backdrop. The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks. Among others, the following stocks were impacted: Infrastructure company Calumet jumped 2%. Is now the time to buy Calumet? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free. Mixed or offshore upstream E&P company Gevo jumped 6.6%. Is now the time to buy Gevo? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free. U.S. shale E&P company Northern Oil and Gas jumped 2.5%. Is now the time to buy Northern Oil and Gas? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free. Oilfield services company Borr Drilling jumped 2.8%. Is now the time to buy Borr Drilling? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free. Oilfield services company TETRA Technologies jumped 3%. Is now the time to buy TETRA Technologies? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free. Zooming in on Gevo Gevo’s shares are extremely volatile and have had 45 moves greater than 5% over the last year. In that context, today’s move indicates the market considers this news meaningful but not something that would fundamentally change its perception of the business. The previous big move we wrote about was 1 day ago when the stock gained 35.7% on the news that the company reported record third-quarter 2026 financial results, with sales and earnings ahead of Wall Street’s estimates. According to a company press release, Gevo reported Q3 2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 94.2% year on year to $82.95 million. Its GAAP profit of $0.09 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates. Results were supported by $29.4 million from Canadian Clean Fuel Regulation credit sales. During the earnings call, CEO Paul Bloom stated, “The underlying earnings power of Gevo is getting stronger, giving us a significantly stronger platform from which to fund and build the next stage of growth.” The company expects further improvements in profitability as it completes debottlenecking, advances its joint venture for plant expansion, and explores additional opportunities in sustainable aviation fuel and technology licensing. Gevo is down 8.5% since the beginning of the year, and at $1.89 per share, it is trading 32.1% below its 52-week high of $2.78 from March 2026. Investors who bought $1,000 worth of Gevo’s shares 5 years ago would now be looking at only $249.34. ONE MORE THING: The $21 AI Application Stock Wall Street Forgot. While Wall Street obsesses over who’s building AI, one company is already using it to print money. And nobody’s paying attention. AI chip stocks trade at ridiculous valuations. This company processes a trillion consumer signals monthly using AI and trades at a third of the price. The gap won’t last. The institutions will figure it out. You need to see this first. FAST

Nov 12 : As Jensen Huang used Nvidia's swelling cash pile to bankroll the AI boom, his involvement went far beyond writing checks.     The Nvidia CEO dug deep into startups' technology, helped them secure customers within his company and even joined fundraising calls to attract investors, according to startup founders, venture capitalists and a former Nvidia employee. "We don't pick winners. We need to support everyone," Huang said on an episode of the "Dwarkesh" podcast in April.  The 63-year-old brought the same intensity to running his roughly $4 trillion chip giant, overseeing some 60 direct reports and personally diving into problems across the company.

That hands-on approach helped make him one of the AI industry's most powerful figures, with influence stretching from Silicon Valley to Washington, where he forged close ties with President Donald Trump and helped shape US chip export policy. It also made him one of the AI boom's great financiers with investments spanning AI cloud providers such as CoreWeave and Nebius and suppliers to the biggest labs. Until it all unraveled on Thursday. First, reports emerged that Huang had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom US authorities identified as a spy for Beijing. Nvidia's board launched an investigation and Huang apologized for his actions: "There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry." The crisis deepened on Wednesday after the New York Times reported Huang had a second affair, this time with an employee who directly reported to him. The board met later in the day and about 42 minutes before market open on Thursday, Nvidia announced Huang was out as CEO. The exit now raises questions about whether Nvidia and the AI ecosystem he helped build can thrive without him. "The bigger concern for me is not the next few quarters but the next decade," said Dan Sheehan, director of portfolio management at Telos Wealth Advisors.  "To find someone who can not only manage an extraordinary business but also continue to innovate and anticipate where the industry is heading. That's a very different challenge."  For now, Nvidia has named Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress interim CEO as it searches for a permanent successor, considering both internal and external candidates. Along with Kress, Ian Buck, who manages hardware and software products as head of product for hyperscale AI, as well as Arm chief Rene Haas, are seen as potential candidates.  Analysts say any successor will have to combine the technical expertise required to run a cutting-edge chipmaker with deep ties across the industry as well as in Washington, where Democrats now control both houses of Congress following a midterm sweep that included campaigns against data centers. "In truth, (it) will be very challenging to find a single person to replace him, so while I expect only one CEO, we could see several high-level hires or promotions that take on different aspects of what Jensen did," said Bob O'Donnell, President and Chief Analyst, TECHnalysis Research. Beyond the operational roles, analysts agree there is one aspect that will be much harder to replace - the cultural clout that made Huang the face of the AI boom, with so much influence that his mere mention of a company could move its shares. "Nvidia has lost the man who helped create the AI revolution, but it hasn't lost the technology driving it," said Sheehan. "The next CEO inherits an extraordinary business, but also one of the hardest acts to follow in corporate history."

Source: Reuters

item.description: [ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 全米リアルター協会（ＮＡＲ）が１２日発表した１０月の米中古住宅販売戸数（季節調整...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米中古住宅販売、10月は5.5％減　16年ぶり低水準 5:16 配信

2026年1月29日、米国カリフォルニア州エンシニタスで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 全米リアルター協会（ＮＡＲ）が１２日発表した１０月の米中古住宅販売戸数（季節調整済み）は年率換算で前月比５．５％減の３７５万戸と、約１６年ぶりの低水準となった。住宅ローン金利の上昇と住宅価格の高止まりで、購入希望者が買い控えた。

住宅購入者向け税額控除の終了を受けて販売が減少していた２０１０年８月以来の低水準となった。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は３８５万戸だった。前年同月比では８．８％減少した。

ＮＡＲのチーフエコノミスト、ローレンス・ユン氏は「住宅ローン金利は、２０２３年の１カ月を除けば２０００年以来の高水準に上昇しており、住宅購入は難しい」と述べた。

地域別では南部、中西部、西部で販売が減少し、北東部では横ばいだった。

中古住宅在庫は前月比１．３％増の１５９万戸。前年同月比では４．６％増加した。

１０月の販売ペースで在庫を消化するのに必要な期間は５．１カ月と、２０１５年１１月以来の長さとなった。９月は４．７カ月、前年同月は４．４カ月だった。

中古住宅価格の中央値は前年同月比０．４％上昇の４２万１９００ドルと、１０月として過去最高となった。

初めて住宅を購入する人の割合は２９％と、９月の３１％、前年同月の３２％から低下した。健全な住宅市場には、この割合が４０％となることが必要とされる。

住宅が市場に出ていた期間の中央値は３５日と、９月の３３日、前年同月の３４日から延びた。

差し押さえ物件を含む不良債権売却は取引全体の２％と、変わらずだった。

現金決済の割合は２９％と、９月の２７％から上昇したが、前年同月とは変わらなかった。

個人投資家やセカンドハウス購入者の割合は２０％と、９月から横ばいだったが、前年同月の１６％から上昇した。

item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
まちまちで取引を終えた。堅調な業績発表などが支えとなり、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続伸。一方、中型株で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（12日） 5:15 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

まちまちで取引を終えた。堅調な業績発表などが支えとなり、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続伸。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．０３％安と反落した。

高級ブランド会社バーバリーは８．０％高。直近四半期の売上高と利益が市場予想を上回り、買われた。エンジンメーカーのロールスロイスは２．０％高。自社株買い計画を発表したことなどが好感された。

増益見通しを示した雑貨ディスカウントストアのＢ＆Ｍヨーロピアン・バリュー・リテールは２０．９％高だった。

一方、金の値下がりを受けて、ＦＴＳＥ３５０種貴金属株指数は５．８８％下落した。

２０２６年第３・四半期（２６年７－９月期）の英国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）は前期比０．７％増加で、２年半ぶりの高い伸びとなった。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

４日続伸して取引を終えた。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は終値の最高値を更新した。堅調な企業業績に加え、アジアや米国の人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株からの資金を移す動きから買い注文が優勢だった。ドイツのＤＡＸ指数も０．４１％高と、過去最高値を更新した。

ドイツの総合電機大手シーメンスは１．７％高。売上高の中期見通しを引き上げ、買われた。スイスの人材派遣会社アデコ・グループは１４．７％高。直近四半期の営業利益が市場予想を上回り、買いが膨らんだ。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種は今年に入って、石油・ガス株指数が３７．７７％、化学株指数は２６．８０％、それぞれ上昇。一方、自動車・部品株指数は１８．０１％、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は２０．８８％それぞれ下落した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りがほぼ横ばい。取引序盤では低下していたものの、トランプ米大統領が「米国はイランとの合意を必要としていない」と発言したことを受け、原油価格が小幅に上昇し、序盤の低下を打ち消した。

トランプ氏はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で、「われわれにイランとの合意は必要ない。そうした時代はとうに過ぎ去った。われわれは彼らの資金、数千億ドルを押さえており、（ホルムズ）海峡も掌握している！」と述べた。これを受け、北海ブレント先物は１％上昇し、１バレル＝９４ドルとなった。

１０日に発表された米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が市場予想を上回る強い結果となったことで、米国債利回りは上昇、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による１２月利上げ観測が強まった。この動きは米国から欧州へと波及した。

コメルツ銀行の金利ストラテジスト、エリク・リーム氏は、ＦＲＢ当局者の発言が引き続き注目されると指摘。「もし当局者が最近のタカ派的な発言を一段と強めるようなら、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の見通しにどういった影響を与えるか見極めるのは興味深い」と述べた。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは３．３２２％と横ばいで推移した。週間ベースでは４週連続で低下した後、今週は約７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の上昇となる見通し。

ドイツ２年債利回りは３．１１４％と横ばい。週間ベースでは４週間連続低下していたが、今週は１５ｂｐの上昇となる見通し。

イタリア１０年債利回りは１ｂｐ上昇の４．３７１％。

ユーロ圏金融・債券市場：[DE/BJ]

Nov 12 (Reuters) – The governments of Colombia and Venezuela said on Thursday they are willing to coordinate security efforts to combat transnational crime following two recent high-profile kidnappings along their 2,219-kilometer shared border.

Colombia is seeking Venezuelan help locating the wife of a Colombian mayor and an army officer.

• Colombia’s foreign ministry spoke with Venezuela’s government “to coordinate efforts to rescue” Nancy Gomez, the wife of the mayor of the city of Uribia, in the northern-most department of La Guajira, some 30 km (19 miles) from the Venezuelan border

Show Full Article

• Colombian authorities believe she was kidnapped on November 11 and taken into Venezuela in an attempt to evade Colombian law enforcement

• Colombian President Abelardo De La Espriella deployed military troops to the area to aid with the search for Gomez, and said the ELN armed group was believed to be behind her kidnapping

• On November 4, a Colombian army officer was kidnapped by the ELN armed group in the town of Saravena, in the border state of Arauca, Colombian authorities said

• Venezuela’s government said it is “fully willing to carry out all necessary coordination” with Colombian authorities on security matters, the Venezuelan foreign ministry said in an earlier statement

• Armed groups, including leftist guerrillas, have historically operated along the border, where drug trafficking and smuggling are common

• Colombia previously accused Venezuela of harboring FARC and ELN rebels in its territory, charges Caracas has repeatedly denied

• Colombian Defense Minister Jorge Eduardo Mora on Wednesday said Colombia had asked the US to work with Venezuela to help find the kidnapped officer

• “We are hoping that with this transition happening in Venezuela, there will be cooperation,” Mora said

• Earlier this year, Delcy Rodriguez became Venezuela’s interim president and began governing the country under US oversight after a US military raid captured then-leader Nicolas Maduro and took him to New York to face trial

(Reporting by Reuters; Writing by Iñigo Alexander; Editing by Anthony Esposito and Daina Beth Solomon)

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 12 : Retail bought the Nvidia dip on Thursday in a big way, showing the AI trade is very much alive despite CEO Jensen Huang’s departure. Nvidia was off 5 per cent on Thursday afternoon following Huang’s resignation, which followed a report on Wednesday that the founder of the second most-valuable US-listed firm had an affair with a company executive who reported to him.  Thursday’s drop put Nvidia’s market-value decline for the week at $550 billion, with selling driven initially by questions about Huang’s relationship with a woman alleged to be a spy for Beijing. But buying the dip has been favored by investors ever since the end of the financial crisis in 2009, and Thursday was no different.  “Every time it works, it gets further reinforced,” said Mark Hackett, chief market strategist at Nationwide Financial in Downingtown, Pennsylvania. “It’s the kind of idiosyncratic behavior that you get in a healthy market.”

The rebound came after Nvidia tumbled as much as 14 per cent at Thursday’s open, extending a torrent of selling over the past month. Vanda Research called Thursday's open the biggest-ever first-half-hour retail flow into Nvidia, estimated at $111 million.   "I said to somebody an hour ago in the office, this feels like the calmest day in markets in a few weeks, which is insane given the news since the last close,” said Jed Ellerbroek, portfolio manager at Argent Capital Management in St. Louis, Missouri. “I think that a lot of damage has been done to Nvidia stock over the last couple of weeks.”  Nvidia stock has lost nearly a third of its value in the five weeks since the Nasdaq Composite hit its most recent high, shedding more than $1 trillion in market value.  On Thursday, retail buyers flocked to popular investment platforms. At Fidelity Investments, customers had placed 394,818 buy orders for Nvidia by noon ET, compared with 80,088 sell orders. Buy orders for Nvidia more than doubled the combined buy orders on Thursday for the nine other most-traded stocks on the platform, with runner-up Advanced Micro Devices showing 24,790 buy orders and third-placed Nebius amassing 24,519. Sentiment was hardly unanimous. On Reddit's popular wallstreetbets trading forum, 60 per cent of comments about Nvidia were negative. A wave of Wall Street downgrades this week hasn’t helped, with analysts at Baird Equity Research on Wednesday cutting the stock to neutral and slashing their price target by 60 per cent to $200 a share, which is still far above Thursday’s afternoon price of $164. “2027 data center forecasts are being delayed due to very recent lack of visibility, with supply issues mostly the reason for a potential slowdown but also due to potential demand softening. AI hyperscaler capex could slow to 40 per cent growth or slightly less for 2027,” senior research analyst Tristan Gerra wrote.  Looking ahead, investors said the key issues for the market include what Nvidia executives say on next Tuesday’s quarterly earnings conference call and Anthropic’s IPO, which is expected to come to market later next week.  “The outlook for AI is going to be just fine,” said Hackett. He said he believes the Anthropic IPO is likely the more important event next week because, with Nvidia’s new management just having started, “It’s going to be hard for them to get a get out of jail free card out of one conference call.”

Source: Reuters

item.title: Mamdani Vows 100 Construction Site Probes After 8 Killed in Building Collapse
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said city officials would commence sweeps of 100 construction sites after eight people died in the collapse of a three-story Brooklyn apartment building.
item.dc:creator: list.metadata.agency
item.content:encoded: (Bloomberg) -- New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said city officials would commence sweeps of 100 construction sites after eight people died in the collapse of a three-story Brooklyn apartment building. The building collapsed shortly after 4 p.m. Wednesday, trapping people inside the rubble, with emergency crews working through the night to rescue survivors.As of Thursday afternoon, the collapse had killed eight people and injured 18, according to the mayor. Two of the dead were children and four of the injured were firefighters. One of those injured was in critical condition, and most of those hospitalized were stable.The city issued a stop work order for the adjoining lot, an excavation site where a new building and cellar had been proposed, according to city building records, which cited unsafe construction operations.Mamdani in a press briefing on Thursday said the city had identified five entities associated with the neighboring construction site, which were associated with 100 other sites across the city. The mayor said the city Department of Buildings would commence sweeps of those locations the same day.“A tragedy of this magnitude demands a comprehensive and thorough investigation that includes both the construction site and the building which collapsed,” Mamdani said. The mayor said the probe “will extend to any and all sites that those who operated these sites are currently operating.”Construction workers were digging on the neighboring lot when the building collapsed, Buildings Commissioner Ahmed Tigani said. Officials don’t yet know how many people were inside the building or how many remain unaccounted for. In March, the city ordered demolition at the site to stop, because “overhead protection was not installed or provided for adjacent properties.” The violation was later resolved and it’s unclear whether it played any role in the collapse.“These were our friends and our neighbors, parents and children,” Mamdani said. “Let us continue to hold close those who have been plunged into unimaginable grief.”--With assistance from Laura Nahmias.More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

item.title: Gold Prices Plunge as Fed Rate Hike Fears Intensify
item.description: Gold prices plunged 3% Thursday to their lowest level in more than a year as a surging U.S. dollar and growing expectations of additional Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes battered precious metals.
item.content:encoded:
News / GuruFocus / Gold Prices Plunge as Fed Rate Hike Fears Intensify

Gold Prices Plunge as Fed Rate Hike Fears Intensify 1 min read

XAUUSD Gold prices plunged 3% Thursday to their lowest level in more than a year as a surging U.S. dollar and growing expectations of additional Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes battered precious metals. The selloff challenges gold's traditional reputation as an inflation hedge, with investors increasingly worried that persistent price pressures will force borrowing costs higher for longer. Spot gold fell 3% to $3,867.96 per ounce by 10:01 a.m. ET, touching its lowest level since October 2025. U.S. gold futures for December delivery declined 3.2% to $3,872, extending bullion's losses for a third consecutive session. The pressure intensified after President Donald Trump suggested Washington no longer needed an agreement with Iran, weakening hopes for an end to the Middle East conflict. Oil prices subsequently climbed more than 1%, reigniting concerns that higher energy costs could keep American inflation elevated. That creates an uncomfortable situation for gold investors. Although bullion traditionally benefits from inflation uncertainty, higher interest rates increase the opportunity cost of holding an asset that pays no interest. Meanwhile, the U.S. dollar climbed toward a 19-month high, making dollar-denominated gold more expensive for international buyers. Tuesday's hotter-than-expected consumer inflation report added to the pressure, strengthening expectations that the Fed will tighten monetary policy further. According to CME FedWatch data cited by Reuters, markets assigned a 91% probability to a 25-basis-point rate increase in December, with expectations for a larger half-point move also rising. The weakness extended across precious metals, with silver falling 3.33% to $49.97 per ounce. Investors Takeaway Friday's U.S. producer price index report represents the next major catalyst for bullion prices. Investors should monitor Treasury yields, dollar strength and expectations surrounding the Fed's December meeting. Another upside inflation surprise could reinforce rate-hike expectations and extend gold's decline. Conversely, softer inflation data or falling bond yields could ease pressure on precious metals. Gold-backed ETFs, mining stocks and silver could also remain vulnerable to further volatility. The key question is whether inflation fears continue strengthening the dollar and interest rates, overwhelming gold's appeal as a defensive asset.
