item.title: DC Shooting Leaves Two Dead, Including Gunman; Four Injured
item.description: A shooting left one person dead and four people injured Thursday in Washington DC’s Logan Circle neighborhood less than a mile from the White House.
item.dc:creator: list.metadata.agency
item.content:encoded: (Bloomberg) -- A shooting left one person dead and four people injured Thursday in Washington DC’s Logan Circle neighborhood less than a mile from the White House.The suspect in the case, a White male, also died, according to a Metropolitan Police Department spokesperson.The chaotic incident led to a massive police response and closed streets, schools, and businesses across the nation’s capital. According to police, the suspect shot and killed a person inside a Vida Fitness gym, and targeted others nearby, including workers at a construction site.He then retreated to a nearby apartment, where he barricaded himself inside and shot at law enforcement attempting to enter. Police established a communication channel but during negotiations, another gunshot was heard. When officers entered the apartment, they discovered the suspect - who they identified but so far have declined to name - with what appeared to be a self-inflicted gunshot wound. He ultimately died from that injury. One victim was in serious condition while three others were being treated for what interim MPD Chief Jeffery Carroll described as non-life-threatening injuries. DC Mayor Muriel Bowser called the incident a “senseless act of gun violence.”“MPD will continue to investigate this situation. But this lone gunman has been contained,” she said.The block, a short walk from the city’s downtown core, is also home to apartment buildings and a Whole Foods grocery store. Bowser said the White House had been briefed on the incident. President Donald Trump has deployed hundreds of National Guard troops in the city in what he has described as an effort to combat violent crime across the capital.--With assistance from Justin Sink.More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

item.title: 追加利上げ必要となる公算、判断急がず＝ＳＦ連銀総裁
item.description:
Ann Saphir
[スタンフォード（米カリフォルニア州） １２日 ロイター] - 米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
追加利上げ必要となる公算、判断急がず＝ＳＦ連銀総裁 4:37 配信

2026年11月12日、米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁　REUTERS/Ann Saphir（ロイター） Ann Saphir

[スタンフォード（米カリフォルニア州） １２日 ロイター] - 米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁は１２日、高止まりするインフレに対応するため、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は追加利上げが必要になる可能性が高いとの見方を示した。ただ、判断を急ぐべきだとは示唆しなかった。

デイリー氏はスタンフォード経済政策研究所で「追加引き締めが必要になるというのが私の基本的な見方だ」と述べた。物価上昇圧力がエネルギーや財にとどまらず、インフレが長引きやすいサービス分野に広がっていると指摘した。

「労働市場は安定し、成長も良好だが、現在、インフレの問題を抱えていることは間違いない」と語った。

最近のエネルギー価格の下落で総合インフレ率が低下した後も、基調的なインフレは、多くのエコノミストやＦＲＢ当局者が予想していたようには鈍化していない。

米労働統計局が今週発表した統計によると、変動の大きいエネルギーと食品を除く１０月のコア消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は、３カ月連続で前月比０．３％上昇した。年率換算では約３．６％以上の上昇ペースとなる。

ＦＲＢは個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数の前年同月比上昇率で２％のインフレを目標としている。エコノミストは、総合ＰＣＥ価格指数の方向性を示すコアＰＣＥ価格指数について、１０月は前年同月比で約３．３％上昇したと推計している。

こうした高水準のインフレを示す指標を受け、複数のＦＲＢ当局者は、次回１２月８─９日の政策会合から利上げ幅を拡大するか、利上げペースを速めることへの支持を示唆している。しかし、デイリー氏は１２日、こうした立場には同調しなかった。

デイリー氏は、債券利回りの上昇を「大いに歓迎する」とし、金融環境の引き締まりによって「慎重に調整した判断を下すための時間がもう少し得られる」と語った。

「市場はインフレを確実に低下させる手助けをしていると思うが、われわれの仕事は終わっていない」と指摘。「だからこそ、追加引き締めが必要というのが私の基本的な見方だと述べている。ただ、具体的な規模や時期については、今後何四半期にもわたり、さらに多くのデータや情報を得られる」と述べた。

デイリー氏はまた、人工知能（ＡＩ）は現時点でインフレや労働市場に非常に大きな影響を与えているわけではないが、今後数年でそうなる可能性は十分にあるとの見方を示した。特に、自身が予想するようにＡＩが生産性の伸びを高める場合、その可能性があるとした。

「現在、かなり深刻なインフレの問題を抱えているからといって、生産性向上の可能性や、それがインフレ抑制につながり得ることを完全に無視すべきではない」と述べた。

最近のＡＩ関連株の評価額の変動についても、技術への期待が薄れたことや、ＡＩが変革をもたらさないとの見方を示しているわけではないと指摘。データセンターなどＡＩ関連の設備投資に資金が殺到していることに言及した。

「成長率を鈍化させても、経済が良好な成長を続け、労働市場が安定し、インフレ率が低下する状況は実現できると思う」と述べた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：民主党の議会制圧、ＦＲＢ独立性を強化　ウォーシュ議長に新たな試練 アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 11/13(金) 7:41 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: プーチン氏、次回和平協議に欧州参加を了承 米欧に対応迫る＝米特使 - Reuters
item.description: プーチン氏、次回和平協議に欧州参加を了承 米欧に対応迫る＝米特使 Reuters

item.title: プーチン氏、次回和平協議に欧州参加を了承 米欧に対応迫る＝米特使
item.description:
Andrew Osborn Maxim Rodionov
[モスクワ １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrew Osborn　Maxim Rodionov

[モスクワ １２日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権のウィットコフ特使は１２日、ロシアのプーチン大統領がウクライナ和平協議の次回会合に欧州の代表が参加することに同意したと明らかにした。ただプーチン氏は、欧州がウクライナで平和を望むのか戦争を望むのかを見極めるため、米政府は欧州の同盟国と協力しなければならないと述べた。

トランプ米大統領の娘婿で米特使を務めるジャレッド・クシュナー氏とウィットコフ氏はこの日、モスクワを訪問し、ロシア大統領府（クレムリン）でプーチン氏と会談した。その後、ウィットコフ氏はロシア国営テレビに「欧州は次回会合に参加する。これは非常に重要な節目だと考えている。欧州はわれわれのパートナーであり、その参加は重要だ」と語った。

欧州の次回協議への参加は、事態打開につながる可能性がある。しかし、戦争終結のあり方を巡ってロシア政府と欧州各国政府の間に大きな隔たりがある中、プーチン氏の発言は交渉の難しさを浮き彫りにした。

クレムリンでの会談でクシュナー氏はプーチン氏に対し、米政府は欧州側に「大きな変化」があったと捉えており、和平協議に欧州が加わっても進展を妨げることはないと確信していると述べた。

プーチン氏は、ロシアはウクライナ問題について欧州連合（ＥＵ）と協議することに常に前向きだったと述べる一方、深刻な隔たりが残っていることを示唆した。「欧州に関して言えば、われわれは欧州との対話に反対したことは一度もなく、対話を打ち切ったこともない。ロシアとの対話を打ち切ったのは欧州側だ」と述べた。

その上で、和平合意の成立後に西側諸国の部隊をウクライナに派遣するという欧州の構想について、ロシアは自国の安全保障に対する脅威と見なすため、戦争の再開につながると警告した。

プーチン氏は「皆さんと米政権全体には、欧州の同盟国と協議し、ウクライナで平和を望むのか、戦争を望むのか、最終的に態度を決めてもらいたいと強く願っている」と述べた。

ウシャコフ大統領補佐官（外交政策担当）は会談後の記者説明で、欧州が次回の和平協議に参加するかどうかを確認せず、ウクライナを巡る欧州の現在の立場は「終わりのない戦争を招くものだ」と述べた。

＜人道支援活動を提案＞

プーチン氏は米特使らに対し、ウクライナ東部コンスタンチノフカでロシアとウクライナによる合同の人道支援活動を提案していると述べた。同市はロシアが支配していると主張したが、ウクライナはこれまで、自軍がなお駐留しているとして反論している。

プーチン氏は、１０月末にロシア支配下にあるウクライナ南部ヘルソン州オレシュキで実施された取り組みをモデルにできると説明した。この取り組みでは、住民の退避が認められ、残留を選んだ住民には支援物資が搬入された。

コンスタンチノフカにはなお４００─５００人の住民が残っており、周辺の地雷除去には５日間が必要だと説明。人道支援活動によって、誰が同市を支配しているのか世界に分かるようになると述べた。

ウシャコフ氏は、ウクライナ東部の都市で共同の人道支援活動を実施するというプーチン氏の提案を米側が支持したと明らかにした。

ウクライナはこれまで、ロシアがこうした活動に伴う停戦を利用して軍の態勢を立て直そうとする可能性に懸念を示してきた。

ウシャコフ氏によると、プーチン氏は１１月下旬に中国で開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議でトランプ米大統領と会い、ウクライナに関する協議を続ける。また、９カ月の中断を経て今週再開したウクライナとの直接和平協議も継続する。

ウシャコフ氏は、ロシア側が米特使に対し、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）のこれ以上の拡大は認められないとの立場を明確にしたと説明。欧州の新たな安全保障体制を巡る協議を欧州側が支持することに期待を示した。

一方、緊張の再燃を示すように、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、米宇宙開発企業スペースＸの軍事向け通信サービス「スターシールド」に、数日前から大きな障害が発生していることをウクライナ軍が確認したと指摘。ロシアと新たな欧州の安全保障秩序を協議する米国の姿勢についても「少し奇妙だ」と述べた。

ウィットコフ氏とクシュナー米特使は、この後ダブリンでゼレンスキー氏と会談する予定。

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 12 : Options traders cashed in parts of their bets against Nvidia and positioned for a longer-term share price recovery on Thursday, after CEO Jensen Huang announced he was stepping down. Huang's departure has raised uncertainty over the future direction of the AI chipmaker he built into one of the world's most valuable companies. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO as the company searches for a permanent successor. The leadership turmoil sent options volatility soaring on Thursday, but options trading suggested that investors were repositioning for a recovery rather than fleeing the stock.  "Nvida's competitive advantage and customers don't disappear overnight," said Seth Hickle, chief investment officer at Mindset Wealth Management. "The market is trying to determine whether this is a temporary leadership crisis or something that fundamentally changes the AI investment thesis."

Options give holders the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell the underlying stock at a set price before a certain date. Call options typically gain value when the stock rises, while puts gain when it falls. Several large options trades showed investors rolling bullish positions further into 2027, lowering upside targets and taking profits on downside hedges rather than abandoning exposure to the company altogether, data from Chris Murphy, co-head of derivatives strategy at Susquehanna, showed. In one trade, an investor sold put options and bought cheaper ones, collecting about $18.9 million while keeping some protection against a further drop, Murphy said. Another investor paid about $18.8 million for call spreads, a bet that pays off fully if Nvidia climbs about 16 per cent from current levels by March. Other trades pushed bullish positions out by three months and lowered the price targets, adding time for a recovery to play out. Investors also bought about 50,000 January call options, spending an estimated $45.3 million to $55 million to bet the shares will rise above current levels by expiry. Nvidia's shares were last down 4.84 per cent at $165.40. Nvidia's 90-day implied volatility has climbed to about 52 per cent from roughly 33 per cent a month ago, reflecting growing uncertainty ahead of the company's earnings report next week, according to Susquehanna data. "Implied (volatility) will remain high until the earnings report, and subsequently the conference call as it can shed some clarity about how Nvidia plans to move forward past this boondoggle," Hickle said.

Source: Reuters

By Patricia Zengerle WASHINGTON, Nov 12 (Reuters) – US House of Representatives Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries called on Thursday for “dramatic change” in the Middle East and reiterated his support for a two-state solution for Israel and the Palestinians.

Democrats’ sweeping victories in last week’s midterm elections could lead to the curbing of US support for its close ally Israel, putting the spotlight on party leaders’ views as they prepare to take control of both houses of Congress on January 3.

Jeffries, a New York Democrat, is expected to be the next House speaker.

Show Full Article

“The status quo is unacceptable, and we need dramatic change. And that looks like, as far as I’m concerned, making sure you have a safe and secure Israel, living side by side as a Jewish and democratic state with an independent Palestinian state that provides dignity and self-determination for the Palestinians,” he said at a weekly press conference.

Next year, Democratic leaders will have the lead in writing bills and deciding what legislation comes up for a vote, although Republican President Donald Trump retains the power to veto measures passed by Congress. It takes two-thirds majorities in both the House and Senate to overcome a veto.

Many of the winning Democrats had campaigned against military aid to Israel and the US-Israeli war with Iran, issues expected to get greater scrutiny in Congress next year.

Washington has historically supported a negotiated two-state solution, although the Trump administration has focused on its own plan for Gaza and a broader Middle East settlement.

The steep toll on civilians of Israel’s campaign in Gaza and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s embrace of Trump and other Republicans had already strained decades of bipartisan support for Israel.

Jeffries called for “dramatic change” in the West Bank, Gaza and to the Memorandum of Understanding with Israel, which provides $3.8 billion in US military aid to Israel each year and expires in September 2028.

(Reporting by Patricia Zengerle; Editing by Jonathan Spicer)

Exclusive-Kalshi says it ended Donald Trump Jr's advisory contract over Polymarket conflict

Donald Trump Jr. speaks at a campaign rally at Eugene F. Kranz Toledo Express Airport in Swanton, Ohio, November 2, 2026. Tom Brenner/Pool via REUTERS

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 12 : Kalshi has ended its advisory contract with Donald Trump Jr after his venture capital firm 1789 Capital increased its stake in arch-rival Polymarket, according to a spokesperson for the $40 billion prediction markets startup. The Democratic sweep of both houses of US Congress in the midterm elections could bring more scrutiny of companies over links to the White House. Democrats have said they plan to use investigative powers on President Donald Trump's family business ties. Kalshi had named Trump Jr a "strategic advisor" in January 2025. Trump Jr was given a stake in the company that the Financial Times reported at the time was worth $300,000. "We have mutually agreed to end Don's advisory role after his firm's significant investment in a competitor this past summer. We are grateful for his contributions in helping us market Kalshi to more customers," the spokesperson said, adding that the conversations to end the contract started in August since 1789 led Polymarket's most recent funding round.

The Kalshi spokesperson said that there were no political considerations that factored into the decision. Two sources familiar with the matter said there had been some concerns raised within the company about potential ramifications of the Democratic sweep. Specifically, the sources said that having the president's son as an adviser might open the company up to scrutiny by the US Congress. The Kalshi spokesperson said the company had not considered or discussed political implications. Kalshi sought inroads with various demographic and political groups in early 2025, according to a third source familiar with the matter. That source said Kalshi contracted with Donald Trump Jr at the time, paying him in equity for guidance in marketing itself to a conservative audience including the MAGA movement. A Polymarket spokesperson declined to comment. Donald Trump Jr did not immediately respond to a request for comment. A representative for 1789 Capital declined to comment. Kalshi started discussing 1789's most recent investment in Polymarket in August when news of the venture capital firm's bet became public, according to a person familiar with the matter. Kalshi reached out to Trump Jr during the fall to discuss the conflict of interest, the source added. GREATER SCRUTINY Prediction markets first rose to prominence in 2024 as they strongly diverged from traditional opinion polls by signaling a Trump victory. Kalshi, at the time, boasted about the accuracy of its own forecasts, while criticizing pollsters and "traditional media" for failing to anticipate Trump’s "decisive victory." Campaign finance and other records show both firms this year have made substantial political donations to both parties, Reuters has reported. Now, such platforms face the prospect of heightened scrutiny in the US Congress. Senator Elizabeth Warren, for instance, has vowed to crack down on insider trading on prediction markets. Earlier this year, Senator Chris Murphy and Representative Greg Casar, both Democrats, introduced a bill to ban prediction market bets on military operations and other sensitive government actions. Several other efforts to rein in prediction markets are also moving forward on Capitol Hill, after a series of well-timed market bets this year fueled questions about insider trading on these platforms, while stoking concerns over the legality and ethics of such trades.

item.description: The Nasdaq 100 turned green Thursday even as Nvidia Corp. NASDAQ:NVDA plunged as much as 14.3% at the open, its steepest intraday drop since the DeepSeek selloff of Jan. 27, 2025, after Jensen Huang ...
item.content:encoded:
News / Benzinga / Nasdaq 100 Turns Green Despite Nvidia's 5% Drop on Huang Exit: Stock Market Today

Nasdaq 100 Turns Green Despite Nvidia's 5% Drop on Huang Exit: Stock Market Today 3 min read

NVDA AAPL CVX GOOGL The Nasdaq 100 turned green Thursday even as Nvidia Corp. NVDA plunged as much as 14.3% at the open, its steepest intraday drop since the DeepSeek selloff of Jan. 27, 2025, after Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive . Investors rotated into rival chipmakers and energy stocks, while Treasury yields jumped. Co-founder Huang stepped down as CEO and board member effective immediately. Finance chief Colette Kress is now interim CEO. At the low of $148.80, the slide had erased about $600 billion of market value. Nvidia then recovered ground to $164.84, down 5.1%, as President Donald Trump weighed in on the succession. “Now That Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place – Tim Cook of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend!” Trump said in a Truth Social post, backing former Apple Inc. AAPL CEO Tim Cook . The S&P 500 rose 0.2% to 7,632, up 12 points. The Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 171 points, or 0.3%, to 52,658. Chevron Corp. CVX led the blue-chip index with a 1.8% gain as crude prices climbed. The Nasdaq 100 rose 0.2% to 28,431. Alphabet Inc. GOOGL gained 2.5%, joining the rally in Nvidia’s rivals, led by Advanced Micro Devices Inc. AMD and Broadcom Inc. AVGO , up 5.1% and 5.5%. The Russell 2000 fell 0.7% to 2,826. Bonds sold off as oil rebounded. The 10-year Treasury yield rose 10 basis points to 5.10%. The 2-year yield climbed 11 basis points to 4.86%, and the 30-year yield added 7 basis points to 5.43%. West Texas Intermediate crude rose 0.5% to $86.92 a barrel, and Brent gained 1.2% to $93.91. Gold fell 3% to $3,881 an ounce and silver slid 3.6% to $50.12. Bitcoin BTCUSD dropped 3.1% to $71,625. On the data front, initial jobless claims rose to 200,000 last week from 191,000, above the 194,000 forecast. Thursday’s Performance in Major US Indices Index Last % Change MTD YTD S&P 500 7,631.61 +0.16% +0.68% +11.48% Dow Jones 52,657.61 +0.33% +1.71% +9.56% Nasdaq 100 28,431.32 +0.20% +0.16% +12.60% Russell 2000 2,825.59 -0.73% +0.49% +13.85% According to the Benzinga Pro platform: The Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (NYSE: VOO ) rose 0.2%. The SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF Trust (NYSE: DIA) gained 0.4%. The Invesco QQQ Trust QQQ edged up 0.1%. The iShares Russell 2000 ETF (NYSE:IWM) slipped 0.7%. Energy Leads as Oil Climbs, Miners Track Gold Lower The Energy Select Sector SPDR Fund (NYSE:XLE) rose 1.8%, the best S&P 500 sector, as crude prices rose. The SPDR S&P Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (NYSE:XOP) gained 2.1%. The Materials Select Sector SPDR Fund (NYSE:XLB) lagged with a 0.4% loss as precious metals slumped on higher yields. The VanEck Gold Miners ETF (NYSE:GDX) fell 2.6%. Utilities rose 0.7%, health care 0.4% and consumer staples 0.2%, while technology and financials were little changed. Despite Nvidia’s slide, the VanEck Semiconductor ETF SMH lost only 0.9%. Fermi Inc. FRMI jumped 21.3% after an investment-grade hyperscaler signed up for 600 megawatts at Project Matador and committed a $200 million prepayment, offsetting a wider-than-expected third-quarter loss. Mobility Global Inc. M MBGL rallied 15.1% after third-quarter revenue rose 7.4% to $478 million, the company lifted its full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance and authorized an $800 million buyback. Figure Technology Solutions Inc. FIGR climbed 11.6% as loan marketplace volume surged 135% to $5.8 billion and fourth-quarter guidance called for $6.2 billion to $6.7 billion. DPC Holdings PLC D DPC gained 6.3% on record third-quarter results and raised 2026 guidance. HubSpot Inc. HUBS rose 7.4% after co-founder Brian Halligan returned as CEO, replacing Yamini Rangan . On the downside, Super Micro Computer Inc. SMCI sank 12.7% after Semafor reported Justice Department probes involving the server maker, Singapore-based Megaspeed and Nvidia. Global Payments Inc. GPN fell 10.8% after a report that private equity firms Clayton, Dubilier & Rice and GTCR had dropped their pursuit of the company. YETI Holdings Inc. YETI dropped 9.6% after third-quarter sales of $509.4 million missed estimates and the company cut its 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $2.90-$2.95, citing cautious consumer spending. JBS N.V. JBS lost 9.5%, extending a slide that began after weaker third-quarter results earlier this week. Millicom International Cellular S.A. TIGO slid 9.3% with no company-specific news, on volume nearly nine times its usual level. Looking Ahead Applied Materials Inc. AMAT , expected to earn $4.05 per share, reports after the close, alongside Cisco Systems Inc. CSCO at $1.33 and Nu Holdings Ltd. NU at 22 cents. BRUSSELS, Nov 12 (Reuters) – NATO will not hold a summit in Albania next year despite previous plans to do so, Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama said on Thursday.

Reuters reported in June that plans for an alliance summit in Albania next year had been thrown into doubt due to resistance from the Trump administration and dissatisfaction among NATO members with Tirana’s low defence spending.

Speaking in Dublin ahead of a gathering of European leaders, Rama said: “The issue is that there is not yet common position on when the summit will happen, for sure not in 2027.”

Show Full Article

He added: “And in 2028, if it will be a summit, it will be in Tirana.”

NATO has been considering ending its recent practice of holding annual summits, a move that could avoid a potentially tense encounter with US President Donald Trump later in his term.

However, diplomats say the alliance could still decide to hold a summit at short notice in 2026 — but not in Tirana.

A NATO official said on Thursday that “the next NATO Summit will be held in Albania. A decision on the date has yet to be made.”

In a declaration adopted at the June 2025 NATO summit in The Hague, the alliance’s leaders wrote: “We look forward to our next meeting in Turkiye in 2026 followed by a meeting in Albania.”

But in a declaration adopted at the alliance’s Ankara summit in July of this year, leaders said, “We look forward to our next meeting,” without specifying a time or location for a future summit.

(Reporting by Lili Bayer and Andrew Gray in Brussels and John Irish in Paris; Editing by Matthew Lewis)

item.content:encoded:
米シカゴ連銀総裁、根強いインフレを懸念　「目標大きく上回る」 2:38 配信

米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁。8月27日、ワイオミング州ジャクソンホールで撮影。REUTERS/Ann Saphir（ロイター） [ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は１２日、最新のインフレデータは望ましい方向に進んでいないとの認識を示した。

グールズビー氏はヤフー・ファイナンスのインタビューで、今週発表された１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）に言及し、「目標を大きく上回っており、これは一時的な動きではない」と語った。 関税などの影響を受けた分野以外にもインフレが見られるようになっているとした上で、「こうした局面では冷静な判断が求められる。われわれは、歴史的に見てどの中央銀行にとってもインフレを解消するのが困難な領域へと、少しずつ足を踏み入れつつある」と述べた。

さらに、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）には政策の選択肢を議論する十分な余地があると指摘。その上で、金融政策の行方について予断を持たないと述べた。

World leaders set out clashing priorities as COP31 turns to negotiations

British Prime Minister Andy Burnham speaks during the UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Turkey, November 12, 2026. REUTERS/Umit Bektas

FAST

ANTALYA: World leaders have set out competing positions and made clashing demands in two days of intense speech-making at the COP31 climate change talks in Türkiye , leaving negotiators with a tough task to draft a meaningful deal that all can agree. Small island states, among the most vulnerable in the world as global warming makes sea levels rise, pleaded for urgent cuts to greenhouse gas emissions. European leaders , meanwhile, lined up behind a proposal to expand global electrification, developing countries asked for more finance from rich ones, and fossil fuel producers said oil, gas, and coal should continue to be used. "We reaffirm our sovereign right to strengthen our energy and oil industry as a driver of our national development," Venezuela's acting President Delcy Rodriguez told the conference, after UN leaders had made the case for bringing to an end the age of fossil fuel.

Apart from trying to accommodate incompatible national positions aired on Wednesday (Nov 11) and Thursday (Nov 12), conference host Türkiye and negotiations lead Australia also have the challenge of trying to make progress when wars and inflation have pushed climate concerns down the political agenda. "It's my job to steer consensus, not to bang tables and demand any particular action, but to steer consensus to the strongest , most ambitious possible out come within the constraints of that consensus-driven process," Chris Bowen, Australia's COP31 president of negotiations , told Reuters. Asked what a good deal might look like, he said: "I have many more hours of consultations with partners to do." Climate activists say short-term political concerns should not get in the way of addressing an issue that will get more pressing if ignored. A UN report last month found the world was already on course to break through the 1.5 degrees Celsius (2.7 degrees Fahrenheit) warming limit that countries had agreed to pursue under the 2015 Paris Agreement to prevent the worst effects of climate change. "The situation could not be less under control. The planet is not dying. It is being killed," Swedish climate activist Greta Thunberg said on the sidelines of the UN conference. "It is being killed by the very same people often thought to come to our rescue. No one is coming to our rescue."

BRITAIN'S BURNHAM BACKS RENEWABLES Earlier on Thursday, the leaders of small island states including the Bahamas, Tuvalu, the Solomon Islands and Saint Lucia called for swift action. "Major emitters must move beyond the usual promises. They must reduce emissions that the climate crisis demands," said Saint Lucia's Prime Minister Philip J . Pierre. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham backed a proposal by Turkey to increase electricity's share of world energy consumption to 35 per cent by 2035, from a little over a fifth now, to help advance that goal. Turkey has not specified whether the extra energy used would be renewable. Burnham told the conference that energy supply disruptions from the US-Israeli war with Iran and Russia's war with Ukraine showed clean energy was the wise choice. "It is now plain for everyone to see that if we depend on energy we do not control, then we leave ourselves exposed to prices we cannot control," he said. "The shift to clean energy is the only r out e to energy security." Developing countries reiterated requests that they have made during many years of UN talks for rich countries to provide more finance to help them shift to cleaner energy, adapt to a warming world , and repair climate-driven destruction. Fernanda de Carvalho, the head of climate policy for the World Wildlife Fund environmental group, said he found the leaders ' speeches underwhelming, especially as COP31 i s the first UN conference since scientists have publicly said the world is set to breach the 1.5C threshold. "It is worrying that the climate issue is not as high on the global political agenda as it needs to be," he said.

item.title: Investors worry the AI trade might lose Nvidia’s largesse after Huang
item.description: As chip giant Nvidia’s chief Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday, investors’ biggest fears were as much about the future of the multitrillion-dollar company as its ability and willingness to ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: SINGAPORE -- As chip giant Nvidia’s chief Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday, investors’ biggest fears were as much about the future of the multitrillion-dollar company as its ability and willingness to continue bankrolling the AI boom. Huang’s exit is yet another pressure point on the global markets’ most crowded trade and came after the board of the world’s dominant chipmaker, at the cutting edge of computing, met late on Wednesday to decide the longtime CEO’s fate after reports of his two extramarital affairs. The company said Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO as Nvidia looks for a permanent successor. Traders’ first reaction was to punish Nvidia shares and those of its customers, including data-centre firms CoreWeave and Naver, while pushing shares of chipmaking rivals Broadcom and AMD higher. Shares in China’s leading makers of graphics processing units (GPUs) surged, as the leadership upheaval at Nvidia boosted expectations that local chip suppliers could win greater market share. Moore Threads, MetaX and Cambricon all jumped nearly 10 per cent. Nvidia shares pared premarket losses but were still down nearly five per cent at 1600 GMT. The worry in the market is that the stakes are far higher and that if Nvidia — under a different leader — backs away from a strategy of financing data centers, then the AI boom itself loses momentum. “Nvidia has been called the ‘Bank of AI.’ They’ll sell you the chips and loan you the money. If they have to take a step back because of what’s going on, will that cut off funding to smaller companies that need it? That’s an open question,” said Joe Saluzzi, partner and co-head of equity trading at Themis Trading in Chatham, New Jersey. Nvidia has been the banner stock of the AI revolution, with its chip technology ahead of rivals and enormous sales driving the share price up some 900 per cent over the four years since the launch of OpenAI’s ChatGPT ushered in the AI era. But Nvidia has also become a torchbearer and financier, anticipating demand for ever more powerful chips while sinking billions of dollars into funding its own customers via a mix of equity investments and other promises. “Nvidia’s credit support is what makes much of this debt finance-able across the AI hyperscaler deal front,” said Christopher Brown, senior vice president, investments, at Synovus Securities. “Lenders will ask what happens to that support if Nvidia’s leadership or regulatory standing is impaired, and Nvidia’s own willingness to extend more guarantees may be constrained.” Nvidia’s board launched an investigation into Huang following reports he had an extramarital affair with a businesswoman who was alleged to be a Chinese spy. A subsequent report about another affair came out ahead of Wednesday’s board meeting. Shay Boloor, chief market strategist at Futurum Equities, said Nvidia’s revenue would not suddenly plunge after Huang’s exit and, therefore, the bigger concern was about the future, given Huang was the person with the vision for computing. “Replacing that strategic vision ... is an enormous challenge,” he said. Nvidia sinks and takes some, but not all, along Huang’s departure leaves a vacuum at the top of the roughly US$4 trillion chipmaker that he co-founded and built over more than three decades to become the top supplier of chips and the nexus of the U.S.-China technology rivalry. Chipmakers in Asia, whose stocks have soared with Nvidia and the AI spending boom, but lately sagged on worries about funding costs and the demand outlook, slipped. Nvidia listed $164.5 billion in financial commitments in its most recent earnings report, with an obligation capped at $105 billion on an OpenAI data centre in Ohio and lease and other capacity guarantees topping $50 billion. In August, it said it had partnered with six major financial institutions including Apollo, BlackRock and Blackstone to launch compute financing platforms aimed at raising over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure. Huang said then the company had the option to backstop up to $125 billion, or 25 per cent of the potential deals. “The interlocking deals that Nvidia has with so much of the industry raises the question into whether that created more stability or more fragility,” said Steve Sosnick, chief market analyst at Interactive Brokers in Connecticut. Nvidia is also one of the investors in Claude chatbot creator Anthropic’s initial public offering. The listing this month is set to serve as a test of investor appetite for all things AI. Shares in Nvidia-backed data-centre operator CoreWeave, which surged on Wednesday on upbeat earnings, fell more than six per cent. Shares in South Korea’s Naver, in which Nvidia took a $1 billion stake by financing a data-center expansion, also dropped six per cent. To be sure, investors said, the quality of Nvidia’s products is not likely to change, and change at the top won’t quickly hit demand. “Nvidia’s core asset is its advanced GPUs, which still have no real substitute in the market,” said Anna Wu, founder of Floodlines Research. “The AI trade rests on that demand, not on one individual.” But when the company reports earnings next week, the focus will inevitably be on leadership, strategy and whether a sales outlook formed under Huang still holds up under a successor. (Reporting by Ankur Banerjee in Singapore, Tom Westbrook in Sydney, Prathik Jayaprakash, Anhata Rooprai, Lakshmi Tharuniyaa, Johann Cherian in Bengaluru and Li Gu in Shanghai; Editing by Thomas Derpinghaus, Vidya Ranganathan, Mark Potter and Emelia Sithole-Matarise)

item.title: 中国「独身の日」の売上高4.8％増 伸び率は25年から減速
item.description: [北京 １２日 ロイター] - データ提供会社の星図数据（Ｓｙｎｔｕｎ）は１２日、中国の「独身の日」セール期間の主要な...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国「独身の日」の売上高4.8％増　伸び率は25年から減速 1:59 配信

2026年11月11日、中国・上海で、JD.comの「独身の日」セールキャンペーン。 REUTERS/Go Nakamura（ロイター） [北京 １２日 ロイター] - データ提供会社の星図数据（Ｓｙｎｔｕｎ）は１２日、中国の「独身の日」セール期間の主要な電子商取引（ＥＣ）企業の合計売上高は前年から４．８％増の１兆７８００億元（約２６７０億ドル）になったとの推計を発表した。人工知能（ＡＩ）を使ったツールや、ライブ配信などを活用してＡＩ関連製品などの販促活動を展開したものの、２０２５年の売上高の１４．２％増からは伸び率が減速した。

１０月７日から１１月１１日までを集計の対象とした。中国では、不動産市場の低迷の長期化や雇用への懸念などが支出を圧迫し、消費者心理が冷え込んでいる。商品の推薦から購入先への誘導、決済まで一貫して担うチャットボットの販売面への効果は、現時点では明らかではない。

アリババ・グループは、新たな技術や消費トレンドなどに関わる新興ブランドの業績を強調した。１０月１５日─２７日に、ＡＩ関連を含む立ち上げから３年以内の３３３のブランドが、各専門部門で１位になったと指摘した。

京東集団（ＪＤドットコム）によると、期間中に５０００万点を超えるＡＩ関連製品を販売し、３億件以上のサービス注文を獲得。ＡＩ搭載のパソコンやワークステーション、ＡＩメガネなどの取引額は前年から２倍以上に増え、大規模言語モデル用の「トークン」パッケージの販売は１０倍を超えたという。

アリババ傘下の「淘宝（タオバオ）」や「天猫（Ｔモール）」、ＪＤドットコムは、取引総額は公表していない。年間を通じて販促が大幅に増えており、独身の日の盛り上がりは以前ほどではないとの指摘もある。

item.title: Pope Leo mulls changes in how Church treats abuse victims in Peru meeting
item.description: Pope Leo met with six victims of sexual abuse by Catholic clergy on Thursday in Lima in his second meeting with survivors during a 12-day trip to South America and discussed how the Church can better ...
item.content:encoded:
Pope Leo mulls changes in how Church treats abuse victims in Peru meeting Reuters | Updated: 13-11-2026 06:22 IST | Created: 13-11-2026 06:22 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Pope Leo met with six victims of sexual abuse by Catholic clergy on Thursday in Lima in his second meeting with survivors during a 12-day trip to South America and discussed how the Church can better listen to abuse victims, the Vatican said. Leo, the first Peruvian citizen to lead the Catholic Church, is on an emotional return visit to Peru through November 16 on the last leg of a three-country tour that has broken crowd records. The pope, originally from Chicago, has met with survivors during several of his foreign visits, in an effort to help repair the Church's standing after abuse scandals tarnished its reputation. The meeting on Thursday lasted more than an hour, said a Vatican statement. "The pope met with each person individually, listening to their stories of suffering and pain," it said. "Together, they reflected on how to foster a change in mindset through listening to victims, seeking the truth, paths toward healing, and a commitment to creating safe environments," it said. Camila Bustamante, one survivor participating in the meeting, told Reuters it was "an important milestone" and that Leo appeared "very committed" to helping victims. But she cautioned that survivors rarely achieve closure in their cases. "Victims are accustomed to persevering, even when things become difficult," said Bustamante, who is also a journalist. "I believe the message must be that we should not give up and that we must continue working for a world without abuse." SURVIVOR GROUP CRITICIZES EARLIER PAPAL MEETING Leo served as a missionary in Peru for about 20 years and was the bishop of the northern city of Chiclayo from 2015 to 2023. Some survivors credit him with pushing for the Vatican to dissolve the Sodalitium Christianae Vitae, a Peru-based Catholic community that faced allegations of sexual, physical and psychological abuse inside the group. The late Pope Francis, Leo's predecessor, dissolved it in 2025. The Vatican said on Thursday that some of the survivors Leo met in Peru were former members of the Sodalitium. The pope, who also visited Uruguay and Argentina on his tour, met with five survivors of abuse in Buenos Aires on Monday. One international survivors' group, Ending Clergy Abuse, criticized that meeting for not including more survivors, including the at least 20 people abused in Argentina at an institute for deaf children in a notorious case. The Vatican, which normally does not discuss how the pope's meetings with victims are arranged, citing victims' privacy, did not provide further information about how the Buenos Aires meeting was arranged.

item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トランプ氏、エヌビディア次期トップにアップルのクック氏推奨 1:16 配信

アップルのティム・クック前ＣＥＯ（左）とエヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンＣＥＯ。5月14日、北京で撮影。REUTERS/Go Nakamura/Pool（ロイター） [１２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の辞任のニュースを受け、アップルのティム・クック前ＣＥＯがフアン氏の後任にふさわしいとの考えを示した。

トランプ大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「素晴らしい仕事をしてきたエヌビディアのジェンセン・フアンＣＥＯが辞任した今、後任にふさわしい人物はただ一人、アップルのティム・クック氏だ」と投稿。「伝説が伝説に代わる！」と述べた。

クック氏は９月、１５年間にわたりアップルＣＥＯを務めた後に退任し、現在はアップルの執行会長を務めている。

エヌビディアはこの日、フアンＣＥＯが辞任すると発表した。フアン氏を巡っては、中国のスパイとの疑惑が持たれている女性や、社内幹部との不倫行為が取り沙汰されていた。

item.title: 米国、ＡＩによる雇用市場の「深刻な短期的混乱」に備えを＝バーＦＲＢ理事
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１２日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国、ＡＩによる雇用市場の「深刻な短期的混乱」に備えを＝バーＦＲＢ理事 0:52 配信

写真はバーＦＲＢ理事。4月14日、米ワシントンで撮影。REUTERS/Evan Vucci（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -  米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１２日、人工知能（ＡＩ）によって雇用市場に「深刻な短期的混乱」が生じるリスクに米国は備えるべきだとの見解を示した。ＡＩの普及速度によっては、労働者が大規模に職を失い、投資家に有利な形で格差が拡大する可能性があるとした。

バー氏はイエール大学での講演原稿で、一部セクターでＡＩが労働の代替となっている兆候がみられており、変化が急速に進めば「大きな混乱が生じる可能性がある」と述べた。一方、ＡＩ企業間の競争により、この技術への幅広いアクセスが可能となっているため、これまでのところ労働者の解雇はほとんど起きていないと述べた。

その上で、ＡＩの影響については依然として不透明だと指摘。その帰結は、ＡＩ企業間の競争が今後も続き、この強力な新技術がインターネットが時間の経過とともにそうであったように「安価かつ広く普及したコモディティー（商品）となり、その恩恵が広く共有される」ようになるかどうかに大きくかかっていると述べた。

バー氏はまた、労働所得の割合が低下していると指摘した上で、ＡＩが資本収益率をさらに押し上げるかどうかは未解明の問題だと述べた。

バー氏の発言は、ＡＩの影響を予測するものではなく、ＡＩがもたらす社会的な緊張への備えを提言するものだ。また、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が任命した作業部会（タスクフォース）が、この新たな技術が経済に及ぼす影響を検討するために１６日にサンフランシスコで開く公開討論会を控える中での発言となった。

item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場・序盤＝ＡＩ関連株急落、エヌビディアＣＥＯ辞任で資金供給懸念 0:30 配信

2018年1月7日、米国ネバダ州ラスベガスで撮影。エヌビディアのジェンセン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）　REUTERS/Rick Wilking/File Photo（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　１２日　ロイター］ - １２日序盤の米国株式市場では、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が大幅に下落した。米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の辞任を受け、資金調達や規制への懸念ですでに動揺していたＡＩ業界に新たなリスクが浮上した。

ＡＩ産業の中核を担う同社は、自社の半導体を使ったインフラ整備に資金を供給している。この戦略には資金の循環を巡って厳しい目が向けられている。

エヌビディア株は一時１２％超下落し、時価総額は５０００億ドル超が消失する勢いとなった。その後は下げ幅を縮小し、約７．５％安で推移した。

セミス・トレーディングのパートナー兼株式取引共同責任者、ジョー・サルッツィ氏は「エヌビディアは『ＡＩの銀行』と呼ばれてきた。今回の事態で資金供給から一歩引かざるを得なくなれば、資金を必要とする小規模企業への供給が途絶えるのか。答えはまだ分からない」と述べた。

エヌビディアが出資する「ネオクラウド」企業のコアウィーブは９．１％下落した。他のネオクラウド銘柄では、ＩＲＥＮやアプライド・デジタルも下落。ネビウスは、２０２６年の売上高が従来予想レンジの下限になるとの見通しを示し、１６．２％下落した。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は１．３％下落した。

フアン氏が６月に「次の時価総額１兆ドル企業」と呼んだマーベル・テクノロジーは３．８％下落。エヌビディアとのクラウド向けＡＩ半導体取引を拡大している大規模クラウド事業者のオラクルは２．６％安となった。

メモリー半導体メーカーのマイクロン・テクノロジーは２．５％下落。データストレージ企業のサンディスクとウエスタン・デジタルはそれぞれ６％、３．７％下落した。光関連製品メーカーのルメンタムとコヒレント、ＡＩサーバーメーカーのデルは３─５．１％下落した。

建設機械・発電設備メーカーのキャタピラーと電力会社ビストラは、それぞれ約０．５％下落した。

一方、ＡＩ半導体を手掛け、エヌビディアと競合するＡＭＤとブロードコムは、それぞれ３．７％、５．６％上昇した。エヌビディアの混乱が競合他社に商機をもたらすとの期待が支えた。

他の大規模クラウド事業者では、アルファベット、アマゾン・ドット・コム、マイクロソフトも０．８─２．７％上昇した。

item.title: クリーブランド連銀総裁、より積極的な利上げに慎重姿勢
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１２...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
クリーブランド連銀総裁、より積極的な利上げに慎重姿勢 11/12 23:58 配信

米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁。2025年4月24日、ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Segar（ロイター） Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１２日、連邦準備理事会（FRB）がより積極的な利上げにシフトする必要があるとは確信していないと述べた。

ハマック総裁はオハイオ州立大学での講演で、「インフレ率を目標の2％に戻すため、金融政策を引き締めスタンスに転換する必要がある」と述べた。その上で、「小幅な利上げをより頻繁に、段階的に進める方が企業や家計の対応が容易になる」とし、より緩やかなペースで行動する方が「より急激で積極的な動きをするよりも、経済全体への混乱が少ない」との認識を示した。

最新の経済データを踏まえると、インフレ圧力が「望ましくない方向に進んでいる」と懸念を示しつつも、FRBが現時点で急速な利上げに踏み切る時期ではないようだと指摘。「FRBが後手に回っているとは思わないが、もしそうなれば、積極的な利上げも選択肢となるかもしれない」と語った。

12月初旬に開催される連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）では、0.25％ポイントの利上げが広く予想されている。一方、ウォラー理事は週初、インフレ状況が悪化すれば0.5％ポイントの利上げも検討すべきとの見解を示している。

ハマック総裁は自身の金利見通しについて、「これは約束でも確約でもなく、議論を呼んでいるフォワードガイダンスでもない。経済の動向に関する条件付き予想だ」と説明。「常に先入観なく会合に臨み、他のＦＲＢ当局者の意見に耳を傾ける用意がある」と強調した。

Zionism is in a deep crisis. Netanyahu is Israel’s biggest liability

The latest Israeli election is seen as a desperate opportunity for Zionism to save itself from the excesses of its isolated leaders.

Manvendra Singh

12 November, 2026 08:25 pm IST

Z ionism is facing its most serious crisis since Israel’s creation. The ideology that spurred European Jews to mobilise for a Jewish state now faces the limitations of its credibility in a world that values democratic and non-discriminatory principles . The circle of critics and those willing to pull back from unequivocal support for the Jewish state range from the political to the football field, from music concerts to mass mobilisations across time zones and language groups.

The latest Israeli election is seen as a desperate opportunity for Zionism to save itself from the excesses of its isolated leaders.

The political cost of supporting Israel unequivocally even had US President Donald Trump ru l ing the consequences.

Show Full Article

He said , “It’s a bad talking point.” He even suggested further financial aid to Israel would be stopped. He had timed his stunning statement just as polls were opening for the recently held mid-term elections in the US . The electorate of the country on which Israel depends for its diplomatic, military and financial support voted resoundingly against Trumpian politics. From posh campuses to buzzing counting centres, the vote was a veto.

Earlier, both 2026–27 UEFA Nations League group-stage matches between the Republic of Ireland and Israel were moved to neutral venues due to security concerns. While one match took place in early October, the other took place in late September. T hen there was the unprecedented spectacle of Irish players with black armbands, heads bowed while the Israeli national anthem played, and finally skipping the customary pre-match handshakes.

The drama was played out well beyond the football pitches.

Earlier in the summer, similar sentiments were on display at sold-out music concerts, on both sides of the Atlantic. Such feelings were replicated in enormous street marches.

‘Isreal exceptionally dangerous’ The American reluctance to march against Israeli policies has been jettisoned in recent years as global audiences and social media imagery brought home ample doses of excesses committed in the name of security. In fact, mobilisation has been demonstrated on Capitol Hill as well, with civil rights groups lobbying American lawmakers against deepening defence ties with Israel.

In September, 56 groups had issued a letter to the leaders of the US House and Senate Armed Services Committees.

“At a time in which American interests are increasingly diverging from those of Israel, and American public opinion is turning increasingly against unconditional support for Israel, creating new points of influence for Israel in the US defence-technology ecosystem is exceptionally dangerous,” states the letter .

This sharp division over Israel is in fact a replica of fissures within the Jewish state as to the direction it is headed and should go. The global drop in support, or even empathy, for Israel is largely on account of the leadership style of outgoing Prime Minister Ben j amin Netanyahu.

Following the surprise Yom Kippur attack of 7 October 2023, the conduct of the war on Hamas and its attacking allies in Gaza has been discussed and commented upon ad nauseam worldwide. Even as it deeply divided Israel, the application of disproportionate force retains its reverberating impact across the West.

Also read: Israel’s 100 shades of racism are on display in its election

A crisis moment for Netanyahu West is, of course, where Zionism began, both as a social as well as a political movement. And the West is where support matters for Israel, a settler state like many countries in the N ew World. Additionally, the West is where most of the leadership of Israel has come from, until the 28 October elections.

Although Netanyahu’s electoral bloc emerged the largest, it falls short of a majority, and those not in the bloc are not willing to touch it.

Gadi Eisenkot’s greatest appeal at the ballot box comes down to one simple truth: he isn’t Benjamin Netanyahu.

Eisenkot will be Israel’s first non-European Prime Minister in a country with a non-Western majority. Historically, the largest number of Jews resided in Arab and Muslim majority lands, with a sprinkling in countries like India. These communities predate European Jewry and outnumbered them too.

Loosely, sociologically and linguistically, these communities have come to be called Mizrahi, or easterner. A word that came to be coined after the formation of Israel, ie Zionist Orientalism.

Israeli television host Yinon Magal, a prominent ally of Benjamin Netanyahu, sparked controversy by calling Eisenkot a “monkey” of “Mizrahi-Moroccan” heritage being managed by “Ashkenazi elites.”

Eisenkot has a month to be the first non-Ashkenazi Prime Minister of Israel. The crisis of Zionism is also very much within Israel, as such blatantly racist remarks reflect. And now they’re compounded by the fact that forming a non-Netanyahu government requires at least the explicit or tacit support of 19 Arabic-speaking members elected to Israel’s Knesset.

Even though Netanyahu is not acceptable to a majority of members, he tried to rally them around forming a national unity government to keep Arab members from influencing the government. Arab votes for a Zionist government are indeed a 2026 crisis moment.

Manvendra Singh is a BJP leader, Editor-in-Chief of Defence & Security Alert and Chairman, Soldier Welfare Advisory Committee, Rajasthan. He tweets @ManvendraJasol. Views are personal.

(Edited by Saptak Datta)

item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任し、コレット...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
〔情報ＢＯＸ〕エヌビディア暫定ＣＥＯ、クレス氏の横顔 11/12 23:28 配信

エヌビディアは１２日、フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任し、コレット・クレス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ、写真）が暫定ＣＥＯに就くと発表した。　Nvidia/Handout via REUTERS（ロイター） [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任し、コレット・クレス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）が暫定ＣＥＯに就くと発表した。以下はクレス氏の横顔。

＜２０１３年からＣＦＯ＞クレス氏は２０１３年９月に執行副社長兼ＣＦＯとしてエヌビディアに入社し、以来この職を務めてきた。四半期決算説明会ではフアン氏とともに登壇してきた。同社の売上高は、クレス氏が入社した会計年度には４１億３０００万ドルだったが、２０２６会計年度には２１５９億ドルに達した。

＜エヌビディア以前の経歴＞エヌビディアに入る前、クレス氏はテキサス・インスツルメンツで８年間財務関連の職を務め、その後１９９７年から２０１０年までマイクロソフトに勤務した。マイクロソフトでは２００６年にサーバー・ツール部門のＣＦＯに就き、同部門の財務戦略、計画、報告を担当した。

２０１０年にはシスコに移り、ビジネステクノロジー・オペレーションズ財務部門の上級副社長兼ＣＦＯとして、財務戦略と事業開発を担当した。その後、２０１３年にエヌビディアへ移った。

＜学歴＞米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）に提出されたエヌビディアの年次報告書によると、クレス氏はアリゾナ大学で金融学の学士号を、サザンメソジスト大学で経営学修士（ＭＢＡ）を取得している。

フォーチュン誌が２０２４年に報じたところでは、クレス氏は大手テクノロジー企業で約２５年間財務関連の職を務めた後にエヌビディアに入社した。同氏はフォーチュン誌に対し、２０１３年に入社した当時、エヌビディアはそれまで働いた中で最も小さな会社だったと語った。

＜契約条件＞会社の委任状によると、エヌビディアの執行役員は特定の雇用期間を定めない任意雇用で、個別の雇用契約、退職金契約、支配権変更に伴う契約は結んでいない。エヌビディアは過去の提出書類で、同業他社の多くはこうした契約を提供していると説明していた。

規制当局への提出書類によると、クレス氏の報酬には譲渡制限付き株式ユニット（ＲＳＵ）が含まれ、その中には４年間かけて権利が確定する２０２６年３月付与分がある。

＜資産＞フォーブス誌は、自力で財をなした米国女性に関する２０２６年版ランキングで、クレス氏を３２位に位置付けている。同氏が保有するエヌビディア株式の評価額は１１日終値時点で約７億５０００万ドルとなり、株価が１０月にピークを付けた際の１０億ドル超から減少した。

item.description: [ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１２日発表した１１月７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新規失業保険申請9000件増の20万件、労働市場なお底堅く推移 11/12 23:11 配信

2025年8月1日、米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１２日発表した１１月７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比９０００件増の２０万件となった。増加したものの、労働市場の底堅さと整合する水準にとどまった。 ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は１９万５０００件だった。

申請件数は９月中旬以降、２０万件以下で推移しており、７月中旬に付けた１９６９年以来の低水準である１８万９０００件に近い水準を維持していることから、労働市場が逼迫しつつある可能性が高まっている。

賃金の伸びが緩やかなことから、一部のエコノミストは労働市場が再び逼迫しているとは見ていない。一方、退職の増加やトランプ大統領政権による移民取り締まり強化を背景とした労働力人口の縮小が、歴史的な低水準の申請件数の主な要因だとする見方もある。

シティグループのエコノミスト、ベロニカ・クラーク氏は「労働力人口の全般的な縮小は、失業保険を申請する労働者の数が減っていることを意味する可能性がある」と指摘。「もちろん、これは依然として低い失業率と整合性がある。継続受給件数の推移を見ると、２０２７年初頭までのデータで失業率が４．０％付近に向けてさらに低下する可能性さえ示唆されている」と述べた。

１０月３１日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は２万件減の１６９万７０００件だった。ただ、継続受給件数には、新卒者や就労歴がほとんどない、あるいは全くない人々など、一部の失業者は含まれていない。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：米財政運営巡る政治対立リスク、民主党勝利で市場が注目 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 アングル：米雇用統計、利下げ観測復活の試金石に　ＦＲＢはなお慎重 アングル：3月米雇用統計、ＦＲＢの金利据え置きシナリオの補強要因に 焦点：ＡＩが10万人以上の雇用に影響か、米映画業界でリスキリング活況 11/12(木) 23:11 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: エヌビディアのフアンＣＥＯ辞任、ＡＩ業界に影響も 暫定トップにＣＦＯ
item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任すると発表し...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エヌビディアのフアンＣＥＯ辞任、ＡＩ業界に影響も　暫定トップにＣＦＯ 11/12 23:01 配信

エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンCEO。7月16日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada/File Photo（ロイター） [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任すると発表した。フアン氏を巡っては、中国のスパイとみられている女性や、社内幹部との不倫行為が取り沙汰されていた。

人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームの主要な原動力の一つであるエヌビディア率いるフアン氏の辞任によって、ＡＩ業界は最も影響力のある推進者の一人を失うことになる。フアン氏が中国市場へのアクセス維持に尽力してきたことや、トランプ米大統領との緊密な関係を踏まえると、同氏の辞任は米国の半導体輸出政策や、より広範なＡＩエコシステムにも影響を及ぼす可能性がある。

また、同氏が時価総額約４兆ドル企業へと育て上げたエヌビディアの後継者を巡る憶測も広がっている。

エヌビディアは後任ＣＥＯの選定に着手し、社内外から候補者を検討するとした。後任選びを進める間、コレット・クレス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）が暫定ＣＥＯを務める。

投資家やアナリストの間では、フアン氏辞任前すでに、クレス氏と同社のベテランエンジニアであるイアン・バック氏が社内の有力後継候補として浮上していた。

米株式市場では、エヌビディア株は一時約１２％急落し、相場全体の重しとなった。その後は下げ幅を縮小し、約５％安で推移した。アナリストは、押し目買いが入ったことで下げ渋っていると指摘。それでも時価総額は約２０００億ドル減少する見通しだ。

競合のアドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）とブロードコムはそれぞれ約６％上昇した。

クレス暫定ＣＥＯは従業員向けのメモで、「取締役会、経営陣、そして私自身、極めて困難な時期にあると認識している」と述べた上で、エヌビディアが米太平洋時間１８日午前９時（日本時間１９日午前２時）に会議を開催すると明らかにした。

ＣＮＢＣによると、クレス氏は同日中にも経営陣を招集する見通し。また、フアン氏は今月下旬の米感謝祭前に議会で証言することに同意したという。

フアン氏はＣＥＯに加え、社長および取締役も辞任する。同氏はエヌビディアの共同創業者で、約３．６１％の株式を保有する第４位の株主でもある。

また、同社取締役で米半導体設計大手シノプシスの元ＣＥＯであるハービー・ジョーンズ氏が、同社初の取締役会会長に就任する。

クリアブリッジ・インベストメンツのポートフォリオマネジャー、マイケル・フェルドマン氏は「リスクは、エヌビディアが突然技術ロードマップを失うことではない。ロードマップは今後数年間、おおむね見通すことができる。リスクは実行力だ。フアン氏は極めて複雑なシステムのけん引役だった」と述べた。

トランプ大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「素晴らしい仕事をしてきたエヌビディアのジェンセン・フアンＣＥＯが辞任した今、後任にふさわしい人物はただ一人、アップルのティム・クック氏だ」と投稿。「伝説が伝説に代わる！」と述べた。

フアン氏を巡っては、シンガポール企業メガスピード元幹部の中国人実業家アリス・フアン氏との不倫疑惑が浮上。米情報機関は同氏について、中国企業へのエヌビディア製半導体の流通を手助けしていたとみている。その後、フアン氏が直属の部下でヘルスケア部門担当バイスプレジデントのキンバリー・パウエル氏とも不倫関係にあったと報じられたことを受け、エヌビディアの取締役会は１１日に会合を開き、同氏の解任を検討していた。

また、情報筋２人の情報によると、フアン氏は別の従業員とも親密な関係にあったという。

フアン氏の辞任は、トランプ政権内にも波紋が及ぶ可能性がある。関係者２人はロイターに対し、ホワイトハウス高官らが、ラトニック商務長官を解任すべきかどうか協議していると明らかにした。ラトニック長官を巡っては、トランプ政権が数十社の中国企業を米国の主要な貿易ブラックリストに追加するのを拒んできたとして、議員から批判が強まっていた。

また、ジョンソン下院議長は、「フアン氏の後任に適切な人物が選ばれることが極めて重要だ」とし、中国への半導体輸出制限について、議会内で合意が形成されつつあるとの認識を示した。

item.title: Trump had urged Jensen Huang to fight for his job, New York Times reports
item.description: Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Jensen Huang, who co-founded Nvidia, will not remain on the board.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid deepening scandal, leaving AI chip giant at crossroads

Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Jensen Huang, who co-founded Nvidia, will not remain on the board.

NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang looks on during the NVIDIA GTC global AI conference in San Jose, California, US, Mar 17, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Carlos Barria)

12 Nov 2026 10:01PM (Updated: 13 Nov 2026 08:58AM)

FAST

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday (Nov 12) after revelations of two extramarital affairs , including one involving a suspected Chinese spy , plunged the chipmaker into crisis and sent shockwaves across an AI industry he helped bankroll. Huang's exit caps a tumultuous week for Nvidia , one of the major engines behind the AI boom, and could have far-reaching consequences for US chip export policy and the broader AI ecosystem, given the ex-CEO's push to preserve access to the Chinese market, as well as his close ties with US President Donald Trump. The crisis has threatened to implicate some Trump administration members, including Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, who is facing growing questions over the administration's oversight of chip sales to China, particularly as both he and Huang pushed for relaxing those sales despite scrutiny from longtime China hawks in both parties. The Commerce Department did not immediately comment. Senior White House officials are discussing whether Lutnick should be pushed out, two people familiar with the situation told Reuters on Thursday.

The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Lutnick's future. Earlier in the day, a White House official said US President Donald Trump "maintains complete confidence in the secretary and his ability to carry out the position." Huang's departure threatens to disrupt an AI ecosystem that he helped shape by pouring Nvidia 's swelling cash pile back into cloud providers, suppliers and the industry's biggest labs. The surge in AI computing demand drove a sevenfold increase in Nvidia 's shares through early October, pushing its market value at one point to nearly US$6 trillion. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO as Nvidia looks for a permanent successor, considering both internal and external candidates, the company said on Thursday.

Related:

Who would be next CEO at Nvidia? Top engineer and CFO favoured as candidates

Jensen Huang scandal could spur tighter US scrutiny of AI cloud providers in Southeast Asia: Analysts

The departure has also ignited speculation over who will ultimately lead the company, long associated with the leather-jacket-wearing Huang, who co-founded Nvidia more than three decades ago. Kress and longtime Nvidia engineer Ian Buck had emerged as the leading internal candidates among investors and analysts even before Huang's departure. Nvidia shares were down about 4.8 per cent, paring earlier losses. Shares of rivals AMD and Broadcom rose about 6 per cent each. Huang, Nvidia 's fourth-largest shareholder with a 3.61 per cent stake, will also leave the board. Nvidia named former Synopsys CEO and longtime director Harvey Jones as its first board chair. "The Board, Estaff (executive staff) and I recognize that this has been an extraordinarily difficult period," Kress wrote in a memo to employees, adding that the company will host a meeting on Nov 18. Kress was gathering Nvidia 's executive team at its headquarters on Thursday, CNBC reported, adding that Huang had agreed to testify before Congress before Thanksgiving. Huang has hired law firm Paul Weiss, the New York Times reported, citing two people familiar with the matter. It was not clear what the firm had been retained to do, the report said. The company has not commented beyond its statement announcing Huang's resignation. REPLACING HUANG Pressure had been mounting on Huang in recent days after reports said the 63-year-old, who is married, had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom US authorities suspect of spying for Beijing. The New York Times also reported Wednesday that Huang had an extramarital affair with a senior company executive who reported to him. While Kress offers investors a familiar hand after 13 years as CFO, analysts have pointed to Buck as a potential longer-term candidate because of Nvidia 's reliance on technical leadership. The veteran engineer helped develop its crucial CUDA software platform and now leads its hyperscale AI products. "The risk is not that Nvidia suddenly loses its technology roadmap ... that roadmap is largely visible for the next several years. The risk is execution. Jensen has been the chief conductor of an extraordinarily complex system," said Michael Feldman, portfolio manager at ClearBridge Investments. "In a world with real bottlenecks, that coordination is a competitive advantage in itself." Investor sentiment toward AI stocks has already been shaky as soaring cash burn and rising debt at traditionally cash-rich tech giants fuel doubts over whether the AI boom will pay off.

TRUMP WEIGHS IN Trump said on Sunday that Huang had "done an amazing job for our country" and that the Nvidia chief had told him he had no idea the Chinese woman he had an affair with was a spy. Trump had urged Huang to fight for his job in a call on Tuesday, the New York Times reported. On Thursday, the US president suggested former Apple CEO Tim Cook should take over as Nvidia 's CEO. US House Speaker Mike Johnson said it was "critically important for right successor to be chosen to replace Huang", noting there was a growing consensus in Congress on limiting exports of semiconductor chips to China. HUANG'S ROCK-STAR STATUS For years, Nvidia was best known to gamers chasing top-tier graphics. But its chips' ability to perform many calculations at once has made them the oil of the AI boom and a strategic prize in the US-China race to dominate the technology. It also made Nvidia the world's most valuable company. That turned Huang into a rock-star CEO, mobbed by fans in Taiwan and South Korea who ask him to sign books, posters and sometimes even their bodies. The scandal preceding Huang's departure unfolded over more than a year, beginning with an October 2025 New York Times report linking him to Alice Huang , a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, a coveted official Nvidia cloud partner with priority access to its chips. Subsequent reports said US intelligence officials believed Alice Huang was acting on behalf of Chinese intelligence. Beijing has denied Alice Huang is a spy. Washington has also investigated Megaspeed over suspicions it helped China obtain advanced AI chips restricted under US export controls, according to media reports.

Related:

Alice Huang barred from re-entering Singapore; insufficient evidence she committed offences in Megaspeed probe: MHA

What we know about Megaspeed, Singapore-based customer of Nvidia

Separately, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday that the US Justice Department was investigating Alice Huang over whether entities linked to her were involved in efforts to smuggle Super Micro Computer products to China, citing a person familiar with the matter. A spokesperson for the Manhattan US Attorney’s office declined to comment on the Bloomberg report. The office previously charged three people associated with Super Micro, including its co-founder, with helping smuggle at least US$2.5 billion of US AI technology to China in violation of export laws. Super Micro did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Earlier, the Singapore Ministry of Home Affairs said Singapore police had been investigating Super Micro as part of a wider probe into Megaspeed and Alice Huang. The police had reached out to the FBI and the Justice Department for help and had received "limited information or assistance," the ministry said. Earlier this month, Nvidia 's board launched a probe, led by independent directors with outside legal counsel, into whether Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. It also expressed confidence in him at the time. The controversy escalated on Wednesday when the New York Times reported Huang also had an affair with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia 's vice president of healthcare, who reported to him.

Source: Reuters/sz/fs

The New York Times also reported Wednesday that Huang had an extramarital affair with a senior company executive who reported to him. While Kress offers investors a familiar hand after 13 years as CFO, analysts have pointed to Buck as a potential longer-term candidate because of Nvidia 's reliance on technical leadership. The veteran engineer helped develop its crucial CUDA software platform and now leads its hyperscale AI products. "The risk is not that Nvidia suddenly loses its technology roadmap ... that roadmap is largely visible for the next several years. The risk is execution. Jensen has been the chief conductor of an extraordinarily complex system," said Michael Feldman, portfolio manager at ClearBridge Investments. "In a world with real bottlenecks, that coordination is a competitive advantage in itself." Investor sentiment toward AI stocks has already been shaky as soaring cash burn and rising debt at traditionally cash-rich tech giants fuel doubts over whether the AI boom will pay off.

TRUMP WEIGHS IN Trump said on Sunday that Huang had "done an amazing job for our country" and that the Nvidia chief had told him he had no idea the Chinese woman he had an affair with was a spy. Trump had urged Huang to fight for his job in a call on Tuesday, the New York Times reported. On Thursday, the US president suggested former Apple CEO Tim Cook should take over as Nvidia 's CEO. US House Speaker Mike Johnson said it was "critically important for right successor to be chosen to replace Huang", noting there was a growing consensus in Congress on limiting exports of semiconductor chips to China. HUANG'S ROCK-STAR STATUS For years, Nvidia was best known to gamers chasing top-tier graphics. But its chips' ability to perform many calculations at once has made them the oil of the AI boom and a strategic prize in the US-China race to dominate the technology. It also made Nvidia the world's most valuable company. That turned Huang into a rock-star CEO, mobbed by fans in Taiwan and South Korea who ask him to sign books, posters and sometimes even their bodies. The scandal preceding Huang's departure unfolded over more than a year, beginning with an October 2025 New York Times report linking him to Alice Huang , a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, a coveted official Nvidia cloud partner with priority access to its chips. Subsequent reports said US intelligence officials believed Alice Huang was acting on behalf of Chinese intelligence. Beijing has denied Alice Huang is a spy. Washington has also investigated Megaspeed over suspicions it helped China obtain advanced AI chips restricted under US export controls, according to media reports.

Related:

Alice Huang barred from re-entering Singapore; insufficient evidence she committed offences in Megaspeed probe: MHA

What we know about Megaspeed, Singapore-based customer of Nvidia

Separately, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday that the US Justice Department was investigating Alice Huang over whether entities linked to her were involved in efforts to smuggle Super Micro Computer products to China, citing a person familiar with the matter. A spokesperson for the Manhattan US Attorney’s office declined to comment on the Bloomberg report. The office previously charged three people associated with Super Micro, including its co-founder, with helping smuggle at least US$2.5 billion of US AI technology to China in violation of export laws. Super Micro did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Earlier, the Singapore Ministry of Home Affairs said Singapore police had been investigating Super Micro as part of a wider probe into Megaspeed and Alice Huang. The police had reached out to the FBI and the Justice Department for help and had received "limited information or assistance," the ministry said. Earlier this month, Nvidia 's board launched a probe, led by independent directors with outside legal counsel, into whether Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. It also expressed confidence in him at the time. The controversy escalated on Wednesday when the New York Times reported Huang also had an affair with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia 's vice president of healthcare, who reported to him.

Source: Reuters/sz/fs

Eight dead after Brooklyn apartment building collapses, NY mayor says

The cause of the collapse of the 1930-era building was not immediately clear.

A view of part of the building one day after it collapsed in Brooklyn in New York on Nov 12, 2026. (Photo: AFP/Charly Triballeau)

FAST

NEW YORK: The death toll from a residential building collapse in New York rose to at least eight, including two children, on Thursday (Nov 12), after more bodies were recovered from the rubble, officials said.

Rescuers worked through the night, searching the site in the Flatbush neighbourhood of Brooklyn where the three-story building collapsed on Wednesday.

They recovered four more bodies overnight, while two others died in the hospital, Fire Chief Lillian Bonsignore told a news conference.

That brought the death toll to eight, including two children, New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani said, adding that another 19 people were injured and one is in critical condition.

"This has been a devastating morning and evening for our city," he said.

Shop worker James Williams, 60, said he witnessed the building collapse after hearing loud banging noises throughout the morning.

"I smelled the smoke from the fumes, and I was watching bricks fall. But to see, like two minutes later, to see the building collapse and fall, it was just devastating," he told AFP.

"There were people trying to get out ... I saw somebody on the side of the staircase, and I'll be honest with you, I didn't even really want to think about that."

Members of the New York City Fire Department and first responders search for victims in the rubble a day after a building collapsed in Brooklyn in New York on Nov 12, 2026. (Photo: AFP/Charly Triballeau)

Another witness, 14-year-old Kenneilia Reid, told AFP: "When I was walking by, I started seeing dust all of a sudden, and I was like, what is going on? When I turned my back, I saw the whole building collapse."

The building, a three-story structure dating from 1930 with four apartments and a commercial space on the ground floor, collapsed onto a nearby excavation site.

A massive emergency response was launched, with about 250 firefighters and rescue workers and search dogs on site.

An adjacent building was also affected, with one of its walls torn away, leaving a staircase and rooms exposed on the rubble.

The cause of the collapse was not immediately clear, and firefighters continued to work at the site on Thursday. STOP-WORK ORDER "My stomach hurts. I can't imagine you were just in your kitchen doing something" and then "you're not any place. It's crazy," Annemarie, a 60-year-old care worker who did not want to share her last name, told AFP. She lives on the street behind the collapsed building.

"It could have been me, you know, it's really scary," she said.

The building fell into an adjacent work site, where construction workers had been excavating, Ahmed Tigani, commissioner of New York's Department of Buildings, told a press conference late Wednesday.

Tigani said that developers had plans approved for a three-story building at the site and were pursuing permission for a nine-story building.

Members of the New York City Fire Department and first responders search for victims in the rubble a day after a building collapsed in Brooklyn in New York on Nov 12, 2026. (Photo: AFP/Charly Triballeau)

According to documents from the city's building department reviewed by AFP, the construction site had been issued a stop-work order in April due to potentially dangerous demolition conditions.

However, work continued, resulting in a US$10,000 fine for the company involved. No link has yet been established between these violations and the building's collapse.

Mamdani said five main entities were involved at the site and authorities on Thursday started "sweeping" 100 other construction sites they are associated with around the city.

The mayor promised a thorough investigation and to hold anyone responsible "fully accountable."

The city's Department of Buildings said its inspectors were on the scene "assisting with recovery operations and conducting structural stability inspections of nearby buildings."

Source: Reuters/as

Global AI stocks sink as Nvidia CEO's exit deepens sector concerns

As the centrepiece of the AI ecosystem, Nvidia finances infrastructure built around its chips - a strategy that has drawn scrutiny over circular funding and now risks weighing on the sector as its crisis deepens.

The Nvidia Corporation's logo during the CERAWeek energy conference 2026 in Houston, Texas, US, on Mar 24, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Danielle Villasana)

12 Nov 2026 09:15PM (Updated: 12 Nov 2026 11:20PM)

FAST

Global AI-linked stocks tumbled on Thursday as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following a deepening scandal around his affairs, upending the chipmaker's leadership and posing fresh risks to a sector already reeling with funding and regulatory concerns. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO as Nvidia looks for a permanent successor, the company said. As the centrepiece of the AI ecosystem, the chipmaker finances infrastructure built around its chips - a strategy that has drawn scrutiny over circular funding and now risks weighing on the sector as its crisis deepens. Nvidia's shares fell 8.2 per cent to a more than 16-month low in early trading and its market value was on track to close below US$4 trillion for the first time since July 2025.

"Nvidia has been called the 'Bank of AI'. If they have to take a step back because of what's going on, will that cut off funding to smaller companies that need it? That's an open question," said Joe Saluzzi, partner and co-head of equity trading at Themis Trading. Nvidia-backed neocloud firm CoreWeave dropped 9.1 per cent after surging more than 27 per cent in the previous session when its earnings ignited a relief rally in AI stocks. Other neocloud stocks, including IREN and Applied Digital, were also trading lower. Nebius dropped 16.2 per cent after the company said its 2026 revenue would come in at the low end of its previous forecast. Nvidia has lost more than US$550 billion in market value since the board announced an investigation on Sunday into Huang's relationship with a businesswoman called Alice Huang, who is alleged to be a Chinese spy. "The interlocking deals that Nvidia has with so much of the industry raises the question into whether that created more stability or more fragility. We're going to find out over the next few weeks as this whole situation unravels," said Steve Sosnick, chief market analyst at Interactive Brokers. Nvidia short sellers have made US$9.6 billion in on-paper profits so far this week, according to data analytics firm ORTEX.

Related:

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid deepening scandal, leaving AI chip giant at crossroads

Jensen Huang scandal could spur tighter US scrutiny of AI cloud providers in Southeast Asia: Analysts

Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang sued over disclosures related to suspected Chinese spy

AI SELLOFF CONTINUES AFTER BRIEF RESPITE Chipmakers, widely viewed as one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, led the selloff with the Philadelphia chips index sliding 1.3 per cent. Marvell Technology, which Huang called the "next trillion-dollar company" in June, slumped 3.8 per cent. AI hyperscaler Oracle, which is expanding its cloud AI chip deals with Nvidia, shed 2.6 per cent. Memory chipmaker Micron Technology fell 2.5 per cent and data storage firms Sandisk and Western Digital eased 6 per cent and 3.7 per cent. Photonic product makers Lumentum and Coherent and AI server maker Dell eased between 3 per cent and 5.1 per cent. Construction and power-generation equipment maker Caterpillar and power producer Vistra slipped about 0.5 per cent each. Shares of AMD and Broadcom, which also produce AI chips and compete with Nvidia, however, rose 3.7 per cent and 5.6 per cent, respectively, on expectations that the turmoil at Nvidia could create opportunity for rivals. Other hyperscalers including Alphabet, Amazon.com and Microsoft were also up between 0.8 per cent and 2.7 per cent. AI stocks struggled and the Nasdaq entered a technical correction earlier this month after the Democrats swept the midterm elections, including in states opposed to data centres, stoking fears tighter regulation could slow the AI build-out. Tech-heavy stock markets across the globe witnessed jitters. Japan and South Korea closed nearly 0.7 per cent lower. Tech stocks in Europe were also down about 1 per cent. Nvidia trades at about 12 times its 12-month forward earnings estimates, its lowest since November 2012, according to data compiled by LSEG.

Source: Reuters/rk

item.title: Chinese Independent Refiners Snap Up Brazilian Crude as Freight Costs Ease
item.description: Chinese independent refiners have purchased millions of barrels of Brazilian crude oil in recent deals, traders said, as easing freight rates improved the economics of long-haul shipments and buyers rushed to use their annual import quotas before the end of the year. The purchases also …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
Chinese independent refiners have purchased millions of barrels of Brazilian crude oil in recent deals, traders said, as easing freight rates improved the economics of long-haul shipments and buyers rushed to use their annual import quotas before the end of the year.

The purchases also reflect a shift away from Russian crude, as persistently high prices for Russia’s ESPO blend have prompted some Chinese refiners to seek alternative supplies from Brazil and other producers.

Totsa, the trading arm of French energy major TotalEnergies, sold about 1.9 million barrels of Brazil’s Sururu and Sepia crude to Hubei-based Jinao Chemical for arrival in late December, traders said.

The cargoes were priced at premiums of around $20 a barrel to the February ICE Brent contract, they added.

Jinao also purchased 1 million barrels of Iraq’s Basrah Medium crude from trading house Mercuria last week at a premium of about $13 a barrel to February ICE Brent for December delivery.

Separately, Totsa sold around 900,000 barrels of Brazilian Sururu crude to Chinese independent refiner Hualong for late-December arrival at a premium of approximately $16 a barrel to February ICE Brent, traders said.

Another independent refiner, Qicheng, bought about 3 million barrels of Brazilian Tupi and Buzios crude for January arrival at premiums of around $18 a barrel to the March ICE Brent contract.

The cargoes were sold by Chinese state-owned energy companies PetroChina and CNOOC, according to the traders.

The deals represent approximately 5.8 million barrels of Brazilian crude purchased by Chinese independent refiners, alongside Jinao’s 1 million-barrel Iraqi purchase.

Prices for Brazilian and West African crude had previously weakened as a surge in tanker freight rates dampened demand from Asian buyers, making long-distance shipments less competitive.

The subsequent decline in shipping costs has improved the attractiveness of Atlantic Basin crude for Chinese refiners, particularly those looking to secure supplies before their annual import quotas expire.

China’s independent refiners, commonly known as teapots, are major buyers of discounted Russian and Iranian crude but also purchase oil from other producers depending on relative prices, freight costs and the availability of import quotas.

The companies involved typically do not comment on individual commercial transactions.

Andrew Silver

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米イーライ・リリーの経口ＧＬＰ－１肥満症薬、中国で初承認 11/12 19:49 配信

イーライ・リリーのビル、カリフォルニア州サンディエゴで2025年撮影 REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） Andrew Silver

[上海 １２日 ロイター] - 米医薬品大手イーライ・リリーは１２日、肥満症治療薬「ＧＬＰ－１受容体作動薬」の経口薬について、中国で初めて承認を取得した。競合するノボノルディスクに先行した。

イーライ・リリーは承認された「オルフォルグリプロン」の中国での価格や発売時期に関するコメント要請に応じていない。

デンマークのノボノルディスクも中国で「ウゴービ」の経口版の販売承認を申請している。

中国でこれまで利用できたＧＬＰ－１の肥満症治療薬は注射薬だけだった。

ＪＰモルガンの中国ヘルスケア調査責任者のヤン・ホアン氏は、中国の減量向けＧＬＰ－１薬の年間売上高が、現在の推定３０億─４０億元から今後５─７年で３００億元（４５億ドル）に達する可能性があると予測している。

Bomb alert temporarily halts trains at Calais station in France, causing Eurostar delays

The alert came amid a broader wave of bomb threats and hoaxes reported in France and other European countries in recent months, targeting flights, schools and, in some cases, media organisations.

A Eurostar train is seen waiting to cross from the Channel to England, at the Calais-Frethun train station in northern France, on Sep 2, 2015. (File photo: AFP/Denis Charlet)

FAST

PARIS: A bomb alert temporarily disrupted train services at Calais-Fréthun station in northern France on Thursday (Nov 12) morning, affecting both domestic and international rail travel. Train services resumed later on Thursday morning after the gendarmerie authorised their restart, national rail operator SNCF said. The national gendarmerie did not immediately respond to an emailed request for comment. International high-speed rail operator Eurostar said some services between London and Paris had been affected by the disruption, as trains traveling on the route pass through Calais-Fréthun. The incident caused delays to services to and from London, the company said. The alert came amid a broader wave of bomb threats and hoaxes reported in France and other European countries in recent months, targeting flights, schools and, in some cases, media organisations. It was not immediately clear whether Thursday's alert was linked to any of the previous threats.

item.description:
Yantoultra Ngui Nikita Maria Jino
[１２日 ロイター] - グーグルの親会社アルファ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アルファベットの香港・Ｓドル建て債、38億ドル発行　需要旺盛で増額 11/12 19:37 配信

グーグルのロゴ、ロンドンで2025年6月撮影 REUTERS/Carlos Jasso/File Photo（ロイター） Yantoultra Ngui　Nikita Maria Jino

[１２日 ロイター] - グーグルの親会社アルファベットが初めて発行する香港ドル建て債とシンガポールドル建て債で、当初目標を上回る約３８億ドルを調達する。旺盛な需要を受けて発行額を増やした。ロイターが１２日に確認した起債条件書で分かった。

両通貨建て債への応募額は合計７０億ドルを超えた。計７本立てで、香港ドル建て債を１６０億香港ドル（２０億ドル）、シンガポールドル建て債を２２億８０００万シンガポールドル（１８億ドル）発行する。応募額には発行を取りまとめる銀行からの注文も含まれる。

ロイターが１１日に報じたところによると、アルファベットは両通貨建て債で計３０億ドルの調達を目指していた。最低で８０億香港ドル、１５億シンガポールドルの発行を検討していた。

起債条件書によると、調達資金は債務返済の可能性を含ね一般事業目的に充てる。

３本立ての香港ドル建て債への応募額は３２５億香港ドル（４１億ドル）を超え、１２日の早い段階の２４０億香港ドル超から増加した。このうち１３２億３０００万香港ドルは共同主幹事からの注文だった。

４本立てのシンガポールドル建て債への応募額は４０億シンガポールドル（３１億ドル）を超え、２５億シンガポールドル超から増加した。このうち９億６５００万シンガポールドルは共同主幹事からの注文だった。

アルファベットは香港ドル建て債の発行利回りは、２年債７５億香港ドルは４．３５％、５年債７０億香港ドルは４．７０％、１０年債１５億香港ドルは５．２０％とした。当初目安の４．６０％、５．００％、５．５０％から引き下げた。

シンガポールドル建て債発行利回りは、２年債３億７０００万シンガポールドルが２．５０％、５年債９億シンガポールドルが３．００％、１０年債３億３０００万シンガポールドルが３．４０％、３０年債６億８０００万シンガポールドルが３．８０％。当初の目安２．７５％、３．２５％、３．６５％、４．００％から引き下げた。

決済予定は１１月１９日、 社債はムーディーズから「Ａａ２」、Ｓ＆Ｐから「ＡＡプラス」の格付けを取得する見通し。

item.description: An Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis killed six people, including a doctor, and wounded at least a dozen, according to Gaza's Health Ministry.
item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / Israeli airstrike on Gaza hospital kills 6, injures 20; sparks tensions

Israeli airstrike on Gaza hospital kills 6, injures 20; sparks tensions An Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis killed six people, including a doctor, and wounded at least a dozen, according to Gaza's Health Ministry.

The damage inside Nasser Hospital after an Israeli airstrike in southern Gaza on Thursday | Photo: Reuters

Reuters 1 min read Last Updated : Nov 12 2026 | 11:56 PM IST

Listen to This Article

An Israeli airstrike targeting the Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza killed six people and wounded at least a dozen more, Gaza's Health Ministry said.   The strike was carried out early Thursday, according to the Israeli military, which said it struck "a senior Hamas terrorist" and other militants, without providing evidence.   The Gaza Health Ministry said the strike hit the hospital's surgery department and that a doctor was among the dead. An Associated Press journalist at the scene said that parts of the building's second floor were destroyed.   Nasser Hospital in the city of Khan Younis is one of the few functioning medical facilities left in Gaza, whose healthcare infrastructure has been decimated by the war. Israel accuses Hamas and its allies of using hospitals as cover for military activity.

Israeli forces have previously targeted Nasser Hospital. In 2025, the military killed five journalists — including AP contributor Mariam Dagga — when it struck a gathering point for local reporters at the complex.

item.description:
Summer Zhen
[香港 １２日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は４日ぶりに反落。米半導体大手エヌビディアの最高経...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝下落、エヌビディアの影響見極め 11/12 18:56 配信

Summer Zhen

[香港 １２日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は４日ぶりに反落。米半導体大手エヌビディアの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を巡るスキャンダルの影響を見極めるなか、警戒感が相場の重しとなった。

中国のＣＳＩ３００指数は０．８％安、上海総合指数は０．７％安で引けた。

香港市場も下落し、香港のハンセン指数は１．３％、ハンセンテック指数は２．４％下げた。

エヌビディアの顧客企業の事業見通しへの悪影響が懸念されている。ｃ

ハンセン指数の主力銘柄アリババ・グループは７％急落し、８月以来の大幅安となった。クラウド事業者による先端半導体の利用に対する米国の規制が厳しくなるとの懸念が強まった。

サクソのチーフ投資ストラテジスト、チャル・チャナナ氏はリポートで「米国の半導体規制強化は、国産半導体への代替を加速させる一方、中国のクラウド企業による先端コンピューティング技術の利用を難しくする可能性がある」と指摘した。

大規模言語モデルを手掛ける新興企業のＺ．ＡＩとミニマックスは、それぞれ９％、８％下落した。

一方、中国本土のＡ株市場に上場する半導体企業の株価は急騰した。エヌビディアの危機を受け、国産品への代替が進むとの期待が高まった。

ムーア・スレッド、メタＸ、カンブリコンはいずれも８％超上昇した。

ハイテク以外では、金関連株、ゲーム株、ロボット関連株が下げを主導した。

香港では、長江和記実業（ＣＫハチソン）が４％下落。傘下の小売企業ＡＳワトソン・グループの重複上場計画を一時停止したと報じられた。

マッコーリー・グループの中国担当チーフエコノミスト、ラリー・フー氏は、中国株の年初来のパフォーマンスは「期待外れ」だと指摘。主な要因として、内需を支える景気刺激策の不足を挙げた。

同氏はリポートで、２０２７年に向けて輸出の強さが「成長率目標の達成に向け、中国政府がどの程度の内需刺激策を講じるかを左右する」とし、それが中国株のパフォーマンスを動かすとの見方を示した。
